text: "Welcome to the fort, foreigner; even if you're not Mercian we will always be hospitable to a traveller in such remote lands. I'm Centurion Hyartis, and this is what remains of the Ninth Legion."
Greetings again, foreigner.
Greetings, Centurion. What do you mean by 'remains'? You were under attack?

"It's complicated. Our Commander, Annaras, was a mighty and loyal soldier of our Kingdom. But he was decreed a Traitor and ordered to return to the capital to stand trial together with all officers;  we of course laughed at the order and remain loyal to him, because he has always been like a father to us all."
But... He isn't here anymore?

The Commander marched east weeks ago leading the elite companies, ordering us to defend the fort until his return.  I am sure he had a plan, maybe to meet with some allies. But it has been a long time and he may not be able to return at all. We can't resist much longer here.
I can see you're in trouble. I've met many deserters in the woods.

Over half the men deserted and I can't blame them. We barely forage enough food, and the natives give us no quarter. And if we ever return to Freetown... We might be hanged as traitors, especially officers. If we remain here we can't last more than a few weeks anyways.
You're not in a good spot. So what will you do now?

"[BLUE](You suddenly realize how young and exhausted he looks)[] I... don't know. I am an officer, and I was close to the Commander, so very likely I'll be hanged. But all I really care about is the safety of my men; I'd give the order march east right now, but if we do, we'll be slaughtered by the natives as soon as we're in the open."
I got rid of Hunting Moon, and the Varannari Warriors are in disarray now. You can leave this camp safely.
I negotiated with the Varannari, and they will let you go... In exchange of a hundred wolf pelts. You don't happen to have them in storage, do you?
I negotiated with the Varannari, and they will let you go. Now hurry, before they change their mind!
I have good news and bad news. The good news is that all your doubts and fears are over, the bad news is... Your life is, too! [RED](Attack)[]

Centurion, I bring good news. The Varannari are willing to make peace with you and allow you to stay here indefinitely. Those of your men that prefer to leave, will be allowed to do so after leaving their weapons.
I need to go.
Have you lost your mind?! To arms! We're under attack!

[BLUE](He looks at you surprised... and somewhat saddened)[] Is she dead? I can't say I am happy about her death, but we are now safe and I am indebted to you for saving my men. I don't have much to give, but here are some of our best standard armors. We will begin the preparations right away and go home.

A hundred! Most certainly not. We did hunt plenty of wolves last summer, let me see what we got. [BLUE](He orders his men to bring forward every pelt in the camp, and dozens of them are quickly piled in front of you)[] Not quite enough, but maybe you can hunt down the rest.

[BLUE](The officer nods and salutes you)[] It's time for me to return my men safely to Freetown then, and face my trial. I thank you, adventurer. I don't have much to give, but here are some of our best standard armors. We will begin the preparations right away.
That sounds... Intriguing, but hard to believe. [BLUE](The man sits down on a stool and invites you to do the same)[]. Explain me the details.

"The Varannari demand that your men submit to the authority of their council of Elders. They'll trade with you all the food you need in exchange of tools and knowledge; your ability to forge and build would be invaluable to them. And you'll defend this land as if it was your own, from now on."
[BLUE](He raises an eyebrow)[] We wouldn't have a problem with that, not most of us at least. But... they'll trust us just like that?

"I am glad you are sitting while you hear the rest. You will have to marry Hunting Moon, and move with her to the Forest. Your men here in the fort will become your 'clan', and you'll be held responsible for their actions; for your own sake I hope they behave..."

[BLUE](The man is completely taken by surprise, and blushes)[] What!?!? Hunting Moon almost beheaded me in an ambush last month. The natives despise us mercian officers, you must be mistaken. There's no way that beautiful Forest Goddess... I mean, that savage... would be interested in marrying me.
Apparently she was very impressed with your... 'survival skills'. This is the best possible deal I could get for your men, Centurion.

Yes, I agree. [BLUE](He sighs)[] And I know this is something I must do, for my men. To be honest this land and people fascinate me, and she is no less alluring. I hope discipline holds among my men or she'll probably break my neck, but it's a risk I'm willing to run. So be it, I will go tomorrow.
Well, congratulations then! I think your alliance, if it holds, will make this place impregnable to any future invasion.

"I agree, and you made it possible. This may not be the outcome I expected, but you prevented a major bloodshed and I am in awe at your way to negotiate with the Varannari. Before the Commander left, he gave me this relic as a farewell gift; Now let this be my farewell gift to you. [BLUE](He hands you an imposing war helm)[]"
Good, given what she plans for you, you won't get to wear any 'protection' at all...
What do you mean? I am sure the Varannari will value my fighting skills! They'll make me a war chief or something.
Oh, I am sure they will. Don't worry about a thing. Goodbye!
It's hard to believe you are so helpless, with so many men here.

"We tried to push back the Varannari, but in our current shape we are no match for them. Their war-chief Hunting Moon is a clever and strong commander; she almost loped my head off. I wish we could parlay, I admire the savages; they're tough, the kind of people that would grow in a merciless and beautiful land like this."
You think of them as 'people' and admire them? Not many Mercians think that way.
Maybe I can find a way to help. Goodbye.
If your problem was that 'Hunting Moon' you should know I got rid of her.

[BLUE](He smiles)[] I'm already considered a traitor so I can speak my mind freely. Tribunes and Praetors get rich off slavery and love that mentality, and some fanatics truly believe it, because many feel comforted by seeing someone is beneath their station. But for the common mercian man? it's nonsense. Slaves are people, of course.

"No one will admit this though, and we will still throw the slurs around and laugh, because that's what everyone does. [BLUE](After his bitter speech he makes a pause and sighs)[] Sorry for my ramblings, adventurer; I've spent a lot of time in this strange land and that has probably made a number on my head. Now please excuse me."
Maybe I can find a way to help. Goodbye.

[BLUE](The soldier salutes you)[] By the Centurion's orders, all travellers are to be given hospitality. However, our resources are limited so I need to ask for a payment of [BLUE]50 gold[]. Are you in need of a safe place to sleep and a warm meal?
Yes, thanks. Here is the money.
Not right now.
You're welcome. You'll get the same 'luxuries' as any legionnaire, which used to mean something back when I was young... Nowadays it means edible supper and a clean mattress, at least. Enjoy!
I will!
You dare coming back? Good, good!
Geetings Impiri, you are welcome in our lands.
You are an Impiri, but you're not one of the wooden-warriors... Who are you?
Hello... What do you mean by 'wooden warriors'?
I am not going to endure your barbaric idiocy. Now die! [RED](Attack)[]
I am an adventurer and I come in peace to visit your lands.
I won't answer to you. Stand aside or try to stop me if you want.

The soldiers south of here, they are great warriors... when their enemies are trees to cut down. [BLUE](All the Varannari laugh)[] But when it's the Free People facing them? [BLUE](He raises his fist and smiles wickedly)[] then they just run like children and hide behind their wall. Now speak, who are you?

[BLUE](The natives discuss for a moment, some of them nod vigorously and then they look at you and bow down)[] You are indeed a friend in deeds, not just words. You have helped Fast Foot and his family, and also Steel Thunder, and your honor and courage have been sung in our night-fires many times. You are welcome!
[BLUE](The natives discuss for a moment, and then face you once more, smiling)[] Yes, we know who you are. You have helped our people and you also proved your worth as a warrior. You may pass.

[BLUE](The natives discuss for a moment, and then face you once more, frowning)[] We never heard of you. The Elder Forest is not for Impiri to wander. Go away!  [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 'friendly' or better with Varannari)[]
[BLUE](The natives begin shouting at each other, some point at you accusingly. Finally they face you angrily)[] You are an enemy of the Free People, now die!
But I have important things to discuss with your leaders! I wish to speak to Hunting Moon about the Mercian soldiers.
Alright, calm down! I'm leaving.
[BLUE](He scoffs)[] Go away, or you'll be talking to your ancestors soon!
You leave me no other option. [RED](Attack)[]
[BLUE](The Varannari charge at you as they howl a battle cry)[]
You're not friendly enough with the Varannari to rest safely here  [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 'friendly' or better with Varannari)[]
You sleep while the Varannari guard you from the wild beasts.
You're not friendly enough with the Varannari to rest safely here  [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 'friendly' or better with Varannari)[]
You sleep while the Varannari guard you from the wild beasts.
You're not friendly enough with the Varannari to rest safely here  [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 'friendly' or better with Varannari)[]
You sleep while the Varannari guard you from the wild beasts.
Hello adventurer. Please don't stand in the way! My wife departs soon and I need to prepare her rations and weapons. [BLUE](He grins)[] I'll be in trouble if she sees me slacking around...
Greetings, Impiri. You have earned your welcome in our lands.

I have been informed of your victory over the enemy leader. Well done, he was a worthy foe and I am certain he'll meet his ancestors with pride and honor. Please accept this token of friendship and gratitude.
Will the Impiri pay their due tribute to the victors?

"[BLUE](You stand before an imposing Varannari woman, taller than any other warrior around. She moves with the grace of a sabercat.)[] Greetings, honored guest. It has been a long time since an Impiri was allowed into the Elder Forest; as the daughter of Chief Laughing Deer, I welcome you into our lands."
I am busy, Impiri. Maybe we can speak later.
I bet the slavers would pay me a fine price if I could drag you to the Freetown Arena.
I am honored to meet you, but I must leave.
Greetings. I know you are the war leader of your people, and I wish to speak to you about the Mercian soldiers in the woodlands south of here.

[BLUE](She narrows her eyes studying you)[] My scouts mentioned that you had visited our enemies. I have to ask, then, whose side are you on? Are you a friend of the Free People, or are you with the Mercian invaders?
Without a doubt, I am on your side and I wish to help you destroy the invaders.
I am not your enemy, but I am here on behalf of the soldiers. They have been left behind by their Commander, and this is not their fight anymore. All they want is to leave your land in peace.
The mercians are broken, and no longer a threat to you. Maybe there can be a compromise and you can let them stay, they could be very beneficial to you.
The mercians are civilized men, as am I, and you will not stop them. Stay away from them or face the consequences, I am warning you.

"[BLUE](She nods)[] Well said. We are stronger and we outnumber them, but their fort can't be taken without a heavy loss to my people, and the deer migrations are about to begin; I can't keep all my hunters besieging that encampment forever. But you can challenge their Clan-Leader to a fight to the death, can't you? I have crossed blades with him and he seemed worthy."

I am afraid the Mercians don't work like that. They are not a clan, and their leader is a veteran soldier and not bound by traditions. He wouldn't accept a challenge to single-combat me, he has no reason to.
I see. If they are honorless, then you can just attack their leader and he will be forced to defend himself or perish.
Are you asking me to take the whole fort by myself?
Of course not. As soon as the fighting begins inside, my warriors will storm their gate. The plan can't fail. Now go, friend of the Free People, and help us remove this threat from our land!
How can we know they really mean to leave, and not just join other armies and then come back stronger?
Their only advantage is the fortification, and they are willing to abandon it. You have beaten them, Hunting Moon. Can't you just accept their surrender and let them go?
You are right, we can't be sure. It is better to destroy them.
If they truly surrender, our traditions dictate we must spare their lives in exchange of a tribute.
What kind of tribute?
Winter is coming, a hundred wolf pelts will be appropriate and shield our elderly from the cold blizzards. No need for them to be perfect pelts.
A hundred?!? That's probably impossible. Can't you accept let's say... forty?

I am no road trader haggling down my prices, Impiri: I am the Guardian of my Ancestral Land, demanding a fair tribute. It's either [BLUE]100 Damaged Wolf Pelts[], or a battle [BLUE](The coldness in her voice makes clear she would prefer the latter)[]
No, just... No. I'll just kill you here and now.
It will be done as you say. I'll be back with the tribute.

If anyone else proposed that I'd just laugh, but you have proven more than once that you care for my people, and at the same time know the Impiri customs more than we do. Only for this reason I will listen to you. Go on and explain.

No doubt this must be Impiri humor... Just go and have some fresh air and maybe we can discuss this another time, more seriously. [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 25, 'Trusted' or better with Varannari)[]
The Mercians have become outcasts, they have no life to return to. If you allowed them to stay in their fort, I am sure they can provide great help to your people.
Help? What kind of help can those dogs offer us?

They know how to forge, how to build tools and houses of stone. And if they become your allies, they know better than anyone how to fight the Legions. They would trade all this for you in exchange of some food and safety, I am sure.

I know your intentions are good, friend. But we could never trust them. There is no way we can be certain that they... [BLUE](The woman suddenly smiles)[]. You changed my mind, I will accept their alliance to us, as long as they accept two conditions.
I am sure they will accept anything you ask. What is it?

Those who prefer to leave can do so, leaving their weapons behind. Those who choose to remain will swear allegiance to our Council of Elders. They will become a Clan and live under the Law of the Forest... And they will work hard for the community, just as my people does.
That sounds reasonable, and it's better to get rid of the unwilling troublemakers anyways. Is that all?

I had a chance to battle their leader. He jumped in front of me so his men could escape. [BLUE](She smiles)[] The fool! I still don't know how he survived my blows long enough to protect his people, but he is a worthy Clan Leader. It is decided: I will take him as my husband, I am sure he'll be capable of protecting my future children just as bravely.

"He'll of course move to my tent, attending all my needs and those of our future children; I will provide for him and watch him. If his kinsmen break the alliance or betray our trust, he'll be held responsible, and I will carry out any punishment."
With due respect, Hunting Moon... We Impiri don't see marriage that way. This is a request that he will decline!
In that case I'll just annihilate them. [BLUE](She shrugs)[]. What you are asking of us is not easy, I must guarantee the safety of my people... Personally.
Alright... I will talk to him.
Not yet, sorry.
The mercians surrender and offer this tribute to your people.[BLUE](Offer the 100 damaged wolf pelts here)[]
I've been giving this matter some thought. Why hunt a hundred wolves instead of hunting just one grasshead spoiled princess? Time to die.
Very well. I still don't understand why you intercede for them, but according to our traditions they may go in peace.

You try to provoke my wrath? You are no longer our guest and it'll be my duty to remove your stain from our holy forest. [BLUE](She calmly unsheaths her sword and approaches you, her bright eyes studying you coldly)[]
[BLUE](Laughing Deer, Father of All Tribes, is an elderly smiling man that doesn't seem to notice your presence. He sits, meditating, while druids care for his needs)[]
[BLUE](Laughing Deer doesn't seem to have moved since your last visit.)[]
I found the Blade of the Deer.
Greetings, Chief Laughing Deer.
I cleansed the Dark Pool. The Nightmares from the witches shouldn't trouble you anymore.
[BLUE](Sit and remain quiet)[]
I need to go.
[BLUE](You feel a strange tension and discomfort, and finally you decide to stand up and leave. You need a reputation of Trusted, 25 or better, to meditate in this glade)[]
[BLUE](Birds chirp, Varannari druids chant softly in the distance)[]
[BLUE](Leaves fall around you, noiselessly)[]
[BLUE](You notice now the sound of the river, as if it was not audible until now)[]
[BLUE](Leaves fall around you, noiselessly)[]
[BLUE](Birds chirp, Varannari druids chant softly in the distance)[]
[BLUE](Leaves fall around you, noiselessly)[]
[BLUE](You notice now the sound of the river, as if it was not audible until now)[]
[BLUE](Birds chirp, Varannari druids chant softly in the distance)[]
[BLUE](A small red viper gets inside your boot. You feel it moving against your foot)[]
[BLUE](The wind brings sweet scent of flowers)[]
[BLUE](Birds chirp, Varannari druids chant softly in the distance)[]
[BLUE](A light but persistent rain begins to fall. Laughing Deer doesn't flinch a muscle)[]
[BLUE](The rain drums noisily over the fallen leaves. You feel cold and your back shivers)[]
[BLUE](The rain stops. Sunbeams pierce through the high tree tops and caress the grass.)[]
[BLUE](Birds chirp, Varannari druids chant softly in the distance)[]
[BLUE](You begin feeling a cramp in your lower back. The pain gets worse every second...)[]
[BLUE](The wind brings sweet scent of flowers)[]
[BLUE](You notice now the sound of the river, as if it was not audible until now)[]
[BLUE](A Deer is looking at you from behind the bushes. At this point, you are unsure if you are dreaming or awake)[]
[BLUE](A Deer is looking at you from behind the bushes. At this point, you are unsure if you are dreaming or awake)[]
[BLUE](You can't resist anymore and fall asleep, exhaust from almost two days of meditation. When you awake you feel thirsty and feverish)[]
[BLUE](The wind brings sweet scent of flowers)[]
[BLUE](Stay motionless and quiet)[]
Chief, do you understand me? I am a friend of your People, I wish to speak to you.
Ugh, now I need to pee.
Chief, do you want some food?
Chief, do you understand me? I am a friend of your People, I wish to speak to you.
Ugh, now I need to pee.
Chief, do you want some food?
Chief, did you see that snake? Whew...
I wish the Impiri rulers also sat all day and did nothing... We'd live more peacefully.
Can we move to a tent? I'm getting soaked.
I really need a towel, Chief.
Chief, do you want some food?
Sitting here is pretty exciting, right?
Ugh, now I need to pee.
Enough of this.
[BLUE](He seems to be meditating and probably can't hear you)[]
Better not to disturb him...
[BLUE](Stay motionless and quiet)[]
[BLUE](Remain calm and, very slowly, begin to remove your boot)[]
Aaaargh! There's a snake in my boot! [BLUE](Remove the boot quickly!)[]
[BLUE](The viper is getting restless and about to bite!)[]
I must remain calm and remove it slowly...
[BLUE](Remove the boot as fast as you can)[]
[BLUE](You get rid of the snake without disturbing the peace of the glade)[]
[BLUE](Your quick reaction and a little luck save you from the venomous bite. You are sweating and panting)[]
[BLUE](The fangs sink into your soft flesh, you feel the poison burn spreading through your leg)[]
[BLUE](Stay motionless, ignoring the pain)[]
[BLUE](Stand quickly, and stretch your back)[]
[BLUE](You resist the pain and focus your mind on remaining motionless. After a while you feel alright again)[]

[BLUE](The pain slowly goes away. You realize you have been sitting for almost one day, and you feel thirsty, hungry and dizzy. Laughing Deer still sits like a statue, looking no different than when you first met him)[]
[BLUE](Stay motionless and quiet)[]
A deer would never be here, so close to the hunters. [BLUE](Stand and walk towards it)[]
[BLUE](Stand and walk towards the deer)[]
[BLUE](The Forest around you has acquired a dreamlike quality. The sky is green, and the river has a golden, shiny color. Before your eyes the beast has transformed into Chief Laughing Deer)[]

"Welcome to the Spirit world, friend. For over a hundred years I have remained here, listening to the Voice and watching over the Clans. For a young Impiri like yourself it's a true feat of willpower to even be here; worry not about the Spirits for they mean no harm to you."
Just to clarify... I am not dead, am I?
You seem very old and wise, can you share your knowledge with me?
What are you doing here?
I had never met before a Varannari which spoke the Imperial language so well.
[BLUE](Laughs)[] You are not. In a few minutes you'll wake up, sitting at the glade.
That's a relief. Let me ask something else...
Impiri... You always want to know and own everything. Some things are never to be fully known or understood. A Mystery is an answer in itself. Just be one with the world...
I figured you would say something like that.
Be quiet and just feel what surrounds you, and what is inside you, Impiri.

[BLUE](Before your eyes the forest dissolves and for a brief second you feel you're about to understand... Everything. You understand the Gods... Or should you say Immortals? Beings that have acquired the Numina, and struggle to not become formless, ethereal power. You begin questioning your true self, and you feel yourself disappearing forever, becoming just another Spirit of the Forest)[]
That's far enough... come back to me. [BLUE](The mighty voice of Laughing Deer suddenly brings you back to your very self. You are again in the Spirit Forest, talking to the Father of All Clans)[]

[BLUE](You don't remember much of what you've seen. One thing you clearly remember from the dreams is how to activate the magical monoliths in this forest. You should be able to use them from now on)[]
Thank you... I'd like to ask something else.

I wage a war. Not a war fought with blade nor blood, but with willpower and belief. The Witches brew Nightmares to slowly slip into the minds and souls of every free soul in Varannar. Men and women, as they sleep, can sometimes hear their voices. Some go mad, others are seduced into their creed.
They have the power to do that?

Luckily the Impiri four Gods destroyed or imprisoned the Great Witches. The ones still in the Undergrove still try to spread their Nightmares, and that is my battle. Their black spirits are like dark clouds that try to sneak past my domain. I hunt and crush them... most of the time.
Is there a way to stop them?
I don't want to get involved in any of this.

Two centuries ago a young warrior of the Deer Clan entered their Coven to fight them, and returned to become a hero and travel to many lands. Find me one of his posessions and I might know more about what happened inside.
One of his possessions? Like what? Where should I find it?
"An item marked by him. I am afraid it can be anywhere; our legend says the hero died fighting dragons in very distant lands."
It's not much... I hope I  can find that item.

That is because I have lived for a long time... Maybe too much. The language you call 'Imperial' is older than your Empire and was also spoken by our ancestors. We are one people with you, although not many know this.
But if we are the same people, why are you...

Greener? Stronger? Not as foolish?  [BLUE](Laughs)[] The Impiri that were our ancestors were fleeing from the other Impiri, and sought the protection of ancient feyfolk called Meliae. Meliae wished to be close to the newcomers and assumed a form similar to theirs, and many mixed their blood with them. We are Men, but we are also Forest.
Certainly that would explain a lot of things... I have other questions. [BLUE](You begin feeling dizzy and confused)[]

You can't stay here any longer, friend. It would be harmful to you. Now wake up! [BLUE](You begin feeling cold, and all of a sudden you open your eyes. You have been sitting in a trance for days, yet you feel rested and refreshed)[].
[BLUE](Laughing Deer nods and smiles with benevolence)[]

[BLUE](You return to the Spirit World and the blade shines with a pale blue light. Laughing Deer takes it carefully from your hands)[] My brother's sword. Yes, this steel is singing a tale for me. This blade is the answer... it has the cleansing power of winter, that renews all life. Go to the Undergrove and submerge it in the Black Pool!
[BLUE](You begin feeling cold, and all of a sudden you open your eyes)[].

[BLUE](You return to the Spirit World and the blade shines with a pale blue light. Laughing Deer smiles at you warmly)[] Yes, my friend. I was at the end of my strength, but soon I will be able to rest easy, knowing the witches won't be able to flood the world with nightmares. [BLUE](He notices your sword)[] I see my brother's weapon now has awakened.
"You try to focus into the Spirit World, but you can't concentrate. The last time you were here, you could achieve it thanks to the sword; maybe bringing here Forest Lament can make a difference."
Yes, it is a fine blade. Can I keep it?
This sword is mine, not your brother's.
This weapon belongs to your people, not to me. [BLUE](Hand him Forest Lament)[].
Of course you can, I am sure you'll put it to excellent use. Goodbye, Impiri. Thanks for aiding us, we won't forget it.
You are strong... But also proud. I guess it's not easy to have one without  the other. In any case, you are correct: you earned that weapon. Farewell!
[BLUE](He smiles and takes the blade. After reciting an incantation, the whole spirit forest around you is suddenly covered by snow. He hands you back the sword, but you notice it has changed)[]
[BLUE](You begin feeling cold, and all of a sudden you open your eyes and wake up from the Spirit Forest)[].
[BLUE](The proud hunter ignores your presence, you need a Trusted reputation, 25, for him to talk to you)[]

I have heard of you. You are the Impiri that has helped the Free People, many times, when we were in need. And you are a strong hunter yourself. I am Star Shadow, Master of the Hunters. Do you seek training?
What can you teach me, Star Shadow?
Thank you, but not now.
I already taught you the ways of the Varannari Beastmaster. There's nothing else you can learn from me.

I will teach you how to be a [BLUE]Beast Master[]. You will learn to cause more damage to beasts, and you can call a Bear to assist you in the Hunt. [BLUE]Beast Master is a General Skill, it will not count as one of your Advanced Skills, nor requires any gold to be learned[]
It will be a honor to learn from you.
Ancient carvings on this monolith have been adorned over the centuries by Varannari paintings. It's obvious this stone bears some significance for the natives
No way I'm touching this.
Let's see what happens if I touch this...
Nothing happens. If there was magic inside this stone, it probably faded a long time ago.
As soon as you touch it, you feel as if you were falling through a very long tunnel...
You seem to be at a different place!
Ancient carvings on this monolith have been adorned over the centuries by Varannari paintings. It's obvious this stone bears some significance for the natives
No way I'm touching this.
Let's see what happens if I touch this...
Nothing happens. If there was magic inside this stone, it probably faded a long time ago.
As soon as you touch it, you feel as if you were falling through a very long tunnel...
You seem to be at a different place!
Greetings, Impiri. Impiri brave and strong, spirits whisper.

[BLUE](As you show him the twisted heart of the beast, the man's jaw drops, then he looks at you with admiration)[] Wolf-father's heart! I will burn it for the old spirits, black wolves will become dumb beasts again,easy prey for us. You deserve a hunter's weapon, take mine.

[BLUE](The native trader is surrounded by various pelts, jars and bottles. His knowledge of the Imperial tongue is poor, but his gestures make up for it)[]. Three Claws welcome Impiri. Beware the evil-wolves!
Greetings. Yes, I've observed some strange looking wolves in this area.
Do you have anything for sale?
I have some wolf pelts.
I have these deformed wolf skulls...
I need to go.
Very evil, but very mighty. I powder three of them, you pay [BLUE]100 impiri gold[] and I make potion for you.
[BLUE](The man smiles)[] Three-Claws great trader, only buys big stacks of pelts. Ten damaged, Five perfect, or three white ones. Otherwise go find lesser trader. You trade?
Yes, I have three white wolf pelts
Yes, I have five perfect ones, very precious.
Yes, I have ten damaged ones, but still useful.
No, sorry, I don't have enough wolf pelts.
I offer you [BLUE]500 gold[] for them.
Deal!
No, thanks
I offer you [BLUE]200 gold[] for them.
Deal!
No, thanks
Too bad. Safe travels then.
I offer you [BLUE]450 gold[] for them.
Deal!
No, thanks
Yes! Worg, and Black Wolf, smells like demon, not beast. Can't be eaten. They attack children and old people at night, kill, then flee... They hide from hunters during day. It's evil witchery...
That sounds like a problem. Can't your hunters get rid of them?
Hunters kill black wolf, hunters kill worg, but hunters can't find the evil wolf-father. More black wolves breed, again and again.
A father of evil wolves? I'll keep my eyes open. If I find it and kill it, I'll let you know.
Beware of witches, Impiri!
Deal! Here are the ingredients.
Maybe another time.

The evil aura that you once felt on this altar has completely dissipated. Once you defeat the Guardian you should examine it thoroughly.
The evil aura that you once felt on this altar has completely dissipated.
Touch the altar with the Winter Wail blade.
Touch the altar with the Forest Lament blade.
Touch the altar with the Ancestral Blade of the Deer.
Touch the altar. Because I never learn!
There's not much to do here.

"Suddenly the whole cave trembles. A dark cloud begins to form above the altar, and then begins to materialize into the shape of a dark dragon... There's a brief flash of light. A magical bridge has materialized over the abyss.
The old notice says: 'Hall of the Four Witch Queens'.
In more recent red painting, you see the word 'Hall' has been dashed and 'Tomb' has been written over it. Also 'Four' has been replaced with 'Three'.
Tomb? That means they are dead, so I guess it's good news then. Right?
Since you are alone, the reply to your rethoric question is an ominous, uncomfortable silence.
The surface of the black liquid is still, no evil emanates from it.
The black water is boiling and suddenly a large bubble bursts, splashing on you a noxious substance. You think you need to eliminate all the creatures nearby before you can do anything here.
The black waters raises and lowers unnaturaly, as if it was a living creature. You are being hurt by just approaching the Pool and breathing the fumes coming out of it.
Submerge Forest Lament into the dark waters.
Drink some of the water.
This thing is dangerous...

Mission accomplished. Laughing Deer should know about this.

"As the black water fills you, you suddenly realize everything around you is a mere illusion, a trick. You need to flee, to escape! Your mind begins to dissolve; this is just the beginning of a nightmare, one from which you'll never wake up."
You manage to save some of it, burning your fingers in the proccess.
The liquid seems to come alive and refuses to enter the vial, splashing your hand in the proccess.
Not bad, coating a blade with this will make a difference.

"If you had not been here, I would have fallen into this trap alone and the evil spirits would devastate the Kingdoms. Now I understand why I was fated to meet you; not because of your own quest, but because of the great threat of Orogg."
I am not so sure it was 'Fate', I think we just fought together like good comrades.

"We did, but it was the will of The Three what brought us together, never forget that.  It was my faith what inspired the vow I made to follow you, even before first meeting you; clearly the Gods knew what was going to happen."
There's no doubt about that. Blessed be The Three.
Alright... I don't think debating this will be a good idea.
May their Light always shine inside our hearts!
[BLUE](She chuckles)[] That may be a wise decision.
So what happens now... 'Your Highness'?
By your words, I deduct you feel your vow fulfilled now, and you'll follow your own path.
I am glad you didn't need to sacrifice yourself, Hirge.
That monk sure said some terrible things about The Three, in particular about Thelume.
Should we do anything else about the betrayal of the monks? We can't be sure there's more of them.
[BLUE](Laughs nervously)[] I am just as glad as you are, or more, believe me. I'm willing to fulfill my duty, but I'd rather live while doing so!
Do you think the Seal is safe now? It will still weaken one day.
It is bright blue which means it'll be strong for twenty years or more. I'll worry about it at the right time, but today we'll celebrate our victory instead.
Can't we just slay all the evil spirits in Orogg?
"We can't; the spirits are not truly alive so they can't die, and they return again and again. There's a reason the Seal was made, unfortunately."

Yes, I feel myself free from my vow and I will follow my own path. But as long as you need my help that path runs along yours. [BLUE](Smiles)[]. I'm in your debt and together we do many good deeds for the Kingdoms.
Oh please, don't start with that... I am just Hirge.
As you command, Lady Hirgalande.
[BLUE](Pouts)[] I beg you to forget about all that, if anyone finds out I'll have to live in the Palace again, and I still have so much to learn!
For your young age you've already done a lot, and you'll one day be a very good queen.

I am of course willing to serve my Kingdom, but I wish I could always do it like I do now: travelling, battling evil, helping those in need by my own hand. I am not made for paperwork, diplomacy or intrigues. I suppose I'll have to learn about that in due time.

"Disgusting blasphemy. I have felt myself the aura of goodness of the Wisest One, and the whole Kingdom is witness of the Mercy and Courage of Nivaria and Arbenos. Sadly it shouldn't surprise us; the most dangerous power of the Witches of Orogg was not their black sorcery, but their ability to poison the mind with their lies."
"I think the Seal is safe, and that's what matters for now; we should, however, go back to Irossia and report all this to Mantros."

I know, and I pray to the Three that maybe he now feels a bit more lucid. We'll find out when we get there.
Let me ask you something else.

This sacred place is guarded by the Order of the Seal and no adventurer is needed... Or allowed.
This sacred place is guarded by the Order of the Seal and no adventurer is needed... Or allowed.

I am one that can renew the seal, Brother. I am Royal Princess Hirgalande, Daughter of Her Majesty Queen Simarie of Ilmara, descendant in direct line from Xoladan the Just and our Mother Nivaria herself. [BLUE](A tense silence fills up the chamber as the monk looks at her in disbelief)[]
You are... Who?!?
Ha! That was a fun one, you got me there for a moment.

"Our dinasty carries a heavy burden. The Sacred Seal was created by Thelume but its source of power was Lady Nivaria's blood, freely given by her Mercy. I can't believe this. There must be another way. You are too young, Hirge.

"Indeed this comes too early as only twenty years have passed since the last sacrifice, this was not supposed to happen for another thirty years. This doesn't make me happy, but I understand your duties and your love for your family and your people.

[BLUE](She smiles and takes your hand while looks into your eyes)[] Those words mean a lot to me. Thanks.
I hate to interrupt but... I thought you were here to help?

Yes of course! You must go now! I will now join my Brothers and tell them of your arrival. [BLUE](The monk runs away through the tunnel)[]

"Actually,  the Seal turns red a year before its magic vanishes so we should have some time still; we can return here another day. Although something might be off here, it has weakened faster than expected so we better check it sooner than later."
Good, so we have some time. I am in no hurry to see you die, Hirge.
Me neither. Just make sure we do this before it is too late...
So what will we face inside the Pits?
Deep inside the mountain there are terribly powerful and evil spirits, but they can't get out because of the Seal, at least while it holds. We should not venture beyond the Chamber of the Seal.
Got it. So we're safe as long as we don't go past the Seal?
The Seal stops the Greater Shadows, but not the lesser evil spirits. This is still a deadly place, my friend. Let's stay alert.

Our land is fertile and our people work hard, traveller... But we live under the threat of the Shadows. [BLUE](She makes a sign with her left hand, probably a protection prayer)[]. We can never feel safe or happy in this harsh land: the shadow of Mount Orogg is long and dark.
How can you survive the threat of the Shadows by yourselves?
With courage and little more. In the days of my father we still had the great weapons of the Spirit Hunter, but we lost them long ago. Maybe in your travels you could find them for us!
Weapons? I could be interested. Tell me more.

Our town was founded in the days of my great-great grandfather, when the Three Impiri Gods killed the great Witches and trapped the evil spirits inside Mount Orogg. Before they left, the Impiri left here a great hero to protect us, so he could hunt down any evil spirit that could have escaped the mountain.
So the weapons you mention were his?

They were. And even after the warrior died, the holy weapons were always passed to the best fighter in Lamis, until they were lost during a Giant incursion decades ago. If you could ever retrieve one of those weapons, certainly we'd be able to deal with the Shadows much better.
I'll keep that in mind, but I might need the weapons myself to face the Shadows.
I understand, but if you can at least bring us one of the weapons we'd be grateful. I believe it is the Forest Mother who guided you here, answering our prayers.
We'll see. Is there anything else you can tell me about the weapons?
I'll certainly do all I can to help. Please describe the weapons to me.

The elders talk about a great Claymore and a Warhammer. Both were made of golden metal, and shimmer with blue energy. We don't know where can they be, we can only hope they were not carried far away or even lost in the seas.
Just passing bye. Goodbye.
What can you tell me about Mount Orogg?
I found this warhammer, I think it is the blessed weapon you're looking for.
I found this claymore I think it is the blessed weapon you're looking for.

[BLUE](She wields the weapon with pride and awe, then bows down at you)[] Your name will be remembered in Lamis, traveller. These enchanted trousers have been in my family for generations, please accept them with my gratitude.
Thanks! And don't catch cold on those legs...

In the days of my great-great grandfather the Three Impiri Gods killed the great Witches and trapped the evil spirits inside Mount Orogg. Some of the lesser Shadows escape the Mount and plague us, but we thank the Gods for protecting us against the strongest ones.
Finally we are here but... [BLUE](The young priestess raises an eyebrow, puzzled)[] I don't understand, the Seal is blue, it is not weakened at all! What is going on here?
Looks like we came here for no reason at all then. I guess it's good news but let's ask the monks about it.
The monks lied to us, this is a trap! Get ready!
[BLUE](Dodge the poisonous darts that were flying to your back)[] Hirge it's a trap! Draw your weapons!
[BLUE](Two poisoned darts sting your back, and you suddenly feel nauseous.)[]
[BLUE](You notice the ambush fast enough to dodge a poisonous )[]
[BLUE](You dodge the poisoned darts and ready your weapons)[]

"Ha ha ha! Just as I planned, the little fly has fallen into the spiderweb; I knew you'd eventually go to your old mentor, and that you'd never tell your mother about the Seal, but come here and sacrifice yourself. Yes, the Seal is intact and will last for decades... Unless we break it."
Sacrilegous traitor... You may have fooled me, and even kill me, but you can't unmake what the Gods made!

"Agreed, we can't. But your divine blood, Your Highness... That's a different matter. Yes, it can renew the Seal; but the Dark Voices that whisper in our dreams have taught us that we can use your blood to unmake the Seal as well. It makes sense, don't you think?"
Why would anyone release the Shadows of Orogg upon the world? What can you possibly gain? Or are you just another foolish villain?
There is a small oversight in your grand plan: me! Now die, traitor.

"I am a fool? At least I am not a pawn. Open your eyes, everything you know about The Three is a lie. Immortal beings and all-powerful, yes, but weak and selfish just as we are.  The vilest of them schemed to get rid of the others, one by one; for him humanity is a tool... or a toy. [BLUE](Smiles at Hirge mockingly as he says the last word)[]. "
Blasphemy! how dare you! [BLUE](Hirge's eyes shine like burning coals as she charges)[]
You notice a small leather pouch stuck in the reeds, a few yards into the waters. The slightliest movement could make it sink into the current.
Let's not touch it for now...
Very carefully, step with just one foot on a tiny rock above the waters, then balance yourself forward until you reach for the pouch.
Use a branch to reach for the pouch.
As soon as your branch touches it, the pouch sinks into the waters with a faint 'plop', never to emerge again.
You bend yourself gracefully and reach the pouch with your fingertips. Once you step back and check its contents, you can't supress a wide smile. It is full with gems!
What happens? Something has changed! I am not invulnerable anymore! But you haven't defeated me yet... I still wield the powers granted by Hell!
[BLUE](The undead monster laughs like a madman)[] Have you come to beg? It doesn't matter. I shall make you suffer when your time comes.
You're the leader of all these monsters and undead. Prepare to die... again! [BLUE](Attack him)[]
Actually... Ahem... I just remembered I double parked my swampdonkey, I must go. [BLUE](Sneak away, quickly)[]
Who are you?

"[BLUE](He laughs even more, making no attempt to dodge your blows. Your weapons slice through him without causing damage; then he claps his hands)[] This is very entertaining. Please keep fighting the beasts outside, it is amusing to watch. Eventually I'll grow tired of you, and then..."

Simpleton, fool! You dare to come here and ask what you can not comprehend! [BLUE](He mocks you with arrogance, but his insanity is obvious)[] I am the one that can fool even the demonic powers! Third door to the setting sun becomes the Gate to Hell...
[BLUE](The monster dismisses you with a waving hand)[] Go and hide, little meatbag, before I decide to come for you...
Your... What?! [BLUE](The expression of shock and confusion in the ghastly face is beyond words. He's probably glad to see you go)[]

Are you undead?

I must continue my exploration. Farewell.
No, my friend. I manifest by the will of The Three. Fear me not, but beware for all kind of wickedness is present around us.

I am a mere vision, a message. But one thing I can do for you: the grate to the Shrine is now open, so you might be able to recover some of my equipment. I am sure they'll do more good in your hands than in this unholy place. But beware the accursed spirits there!

I raised this Abbey right here so we could preach to the nearby Varannari about The Three. And many of them did embrace the Faith, but unfortunately not all. Among them, many bow down to the Powers of Night, and some are chosen as priestess: the witches.
Oh, I've already met a bunch of them.

They deal with forces of the Abyss. They tried to corrupt me, offered me a way to earn back my lost throne, and the heart of my beloved. I denied them, but my sucessor Marcillus seems to have fallen for their temptations. What was the deal, I don't know.
I'll try to find out more about it.

Hmmm... Maybe here I can find something useful regarding the Abbot's soul and why his deal with the devils didn't work as they expected.

So that's what keeps him bound here, his Oath to Saint Admus.

... But the king interrupted the wizard, for he wanted a clear answer. The wizard then nodded and said just one word: truth. And I agree with him, for what are all virtues worth in a knight if Honesty isn't above all else?'

Welcome to the Abbey of Saint Admus. Please respect the peace and sanctity of the temple. Signed: Abbot Marcillus.
To the Abbot's Quarters

Varsilia.

Courage.
Compassion.
Wisdom.
Honesty.

Now everything is in order concerning the Abbot. However it might take me a century to sort out all the paperwork for his men... But they'll remain within the abbey while we sort them out.

I am a customer. In particular, your final customer. Now die, hellspawn.
"The Abbot made a deal with you; now he regrets it, and I'm here to solve this situation."
What the hell... Who or what are you, demon?
Leave me alone, demon.
Where does that Teleportation Circle go?
Excuse my manners, here is my card. I'm a representative from Firepits & Fine Prints, specialists in trading with mortals.
Really? I am going to destroy you with great pleasure.
Yeah, you looked the type to me. Let me ask you something.
So... Can I sell you my soul?
Sure thing, how may I help you?

[BLUE](He smiles broadly)[] Oh, you are a fellow legal representative then! I'm so glad to meet a colleage. Let me ask you, do you charge clients per hour, or per level? Anyways, we can chat about that later, let me check the Abbot's file...

Hmmm... He's quite a piece of work, isn't he? Corrupted by Varannari Witches, he sacrificed a poor commoner girl to summon us. We gave him power in exchange of his soul, and he used that power to kidnap and murder. And now he doesn't want to fulfill the contract...
I really don't care much about him, he deserves damnation. But he and his men keep haunting the place. Wraiths wander around the Abbey at night. I want to get rid of them.
It doesn't matter what the Abbot and his men did, I won't allow you to take their souls to hell.

Definitely I'm on your side here. My boss has invested too many resources into this already, and the situation has stalled. For some reason, the Abbot's soul, and the souls of his men, refuse to come down and remain as wraiths. Somehow he has fooled us.
But how? I thought if he agreed to sell you his soul, he'd just be forced to pay when he died.

"There's something that keeps the Abbot's soul bound here. Maybe the answer lies somewhere upstairs; however I am a letters' man, and I have no intention to be hacked to pieces by the witches and their kitten. I guess we'll be stuck here for a long time."

I see you're a professional lawman, always behind your client. Well done! You'd do well at my firm. However this is not a matter of me wanting him in hell or not: he literally sold his soul. Yet for some reason it didn't come down after his death. Unbelievable.
"Allow me to present my Pleading. By removing me you accomplish nothing; another designated legal representative will be transferred tomorrow to take my position."
Alright, just listening to you gives me a headache. Goodbye.
Plead all you want, you devil. Your time has come.
No offense meant, but your credit is in the red. Sorry but not interested.
That has to be a mistake, I am a nice person!
Yeah yeah, feel free to file a complaint.
Ha! Don't be afraid, it doesn't take you 'downstairs', but upstairs, near the Abbot's quarters.
[BLUE](The Mist Hunter officer salutes you)[]May the Three guard your passage through our lands, foreigner. I advise to avoid travelling at night.
Greetings. Anything you can tell me about this land, captain?
Thanks. I've come here after a rumor of a giant Mirmek sighted north of here.
Hello, good ranger. Can you give me some advice regarding the lands north of Fögas?
Thanks to The Three the wraiths are no longer besieging the town at night. We remain vigilant, nonetheless.
I won't lie to you. The reason we were deployed here is there's indeed great danger around Fögas, especially at nights. We're keeping the village safe, but little else.
What kind of danger?

"Wraiths. They come from the forest each night, and surround the town. At first we tried to battle to the last of them, but then I noticed they keep coming back the next night; we just focus on defending the town, until we find out where they come from."
Thanks for the warning. I'll try to travel during the day.
Do you have any theories about why the wraiths keep coming?
"I am a ranger, not a scholar; the local priestess is trying to learn more about this, feel free to talk to her."

Oh yes, that gigantic insect enveloped in magic flames. Blaze was visible miles away, far to the north. Right when we were ready to send an expedition to deal with it,  my explorers returned with good news: the beast was vanquished.
Really? What happened?

A foreigner woman took care of it. And since she lives in that cave in the Highlands, the deadly Vorators don't come out either, blessed be her! It's said she can heal the sickness of the mind, and people murmur that she's the Chosen of Arbenos, and call her the Flame Prophet.
And where is that cave? I might want to have a look at the beast's corpse.
North of here, in the Iross Highlands. The cave is not easy to find, but it's past the burning forest.
The Iross Highlands? Any advice about the place would be welcome.
Thanks for the information.

The Iross Highlands are deadly at night, avoid staying after dusk. Woodsmen live there but they're strange people, not Believers, very violent. Also, there's a forest which was set ablaze by a fiery beast, and by some odd magic it still burns without consuming the trees.
My trust in you was well placed. Whatever you did in that accursed place seems to have sent the wraiths away! Here is the small reward our small congregation can afford.
Welcome again. I pray for your success in stopping those wraiths from the forest.
[BLUE](The woman bows down)[] Welcome to this humble shrine. May the Three guide your steps.
I require healing
Can you answer some questions about The Three?
Can I be of service to The Three?
Tell me the story of Saint Admus and the Abbey.
I must be on my way.
I can heal you, in exchange of a small contribution to our Shrine.

I wish to make a large donation then. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 60 gold coins, be healed for 80hp)[]
Not at the moment thanks. I better be on my way.
By the Power of Arbenos, Thelume and Nivaria, be healed of your wounds!
[BLUE](The woman nods )[] The knowledge I may humbly have is yours. Ask away.

Priests have told me about how in the early days of the Kingdom, The Three intervened directly to help the innocent and vanquish evil. Why are the Kingdoms now left exposed to many monsters and dangers, and they don't save us?
We're in Ilmara, I know here religion is above all. Then why are you here in a small Shrine, instead of having built a temple?
Everybody here worship The Three, or there are other cults and priests?

An interesting question... But my answer would be that they indeed intervene, every day. They gave their powers to hundreds of clerics, which heal the sick and battle evil as we speak, from the burning sands of Inori to the frozen peaks of the north.
"Still, we humans are struggling for survival in Varannar; there's more monsters and more evil each day."
That explains it. Thanks.
Just be strong in your faith, and open your mind to the Virtues of The Three: Wisdom, Courage and Compassion. That is their greatest gift, truly, and the one that will save humanity one day.
Answer another question for me, please.
Thanks. Enough teachings for now. I must be going.
What else do you want to know?

[BLUE](The woman chuckles)[] A fair question. We priests are to remain humble, and in the service of our people. Thelume the Wise, one of the Three, instructed our Queen not to build temples, except in large cities that can actually afford them.

Here in Ilmara almost everyone is a Believer, but of course a few choose other faiths. As long as they are not evil cults, they have the freedom to pray to whatever pantheon they choose, or to none at all. Such was Thelume's Will, in the Book of the Moon.

I am in need of help, yes... But this is a very dangerous mission, one I can only entrust to someone experienced against the undead. [BLUE](You need a reputation of 25 with The Three for this quest)[]

We need all the help we can get. Maybe you have already talked to the Captain about the wraiths that surround the town every night. The Mist Hunters are capable of keeping them at bay for now, but we don't know what's behind them, and what may happen next.
Do you have any theories about where they might be coming from?
I might come back later to talk about this.

[BLUE](You see anger, shame and frustration in the young hunter's eyes, but he nods and then all of them depart quickly)[]

[BLUE](The creature looks excited, but does not attack. Instead he smiles and bows down)[] Master! Master! Master is back, finally! Master will put order and make things right!

I have bad news. I don't have the power you think I have. You say you feel I am the Master, but I am just his descendant. I have the key, but I have no idea how to activate anything here.
No... That door outside is just to stop curious adventurers and door-to-door salesmen. Door here, real magical defense. Only the key,charged with power of the Master can open it!

the Master's Key! Yes! But it is not charged. It won't work. Use your power to charge it, Master!

Damn, the tower has a ghost, and a sarcastic one too. Why couldn't I just inherit a big pile of gold?
Grandfather! Is it you? I think I am going to cry.
Undead abomination, you are a mockery of what my ancestor was. I shall destroy you.

That's interesting. So, what can you do for me? can you cast spells or teach me useful things?

You think I am a here for your amusement? I am here to warn you about a great danger, a threat to our whole world. The [BLUE]Forsaken[] are planning to open a [BLUE]Deep Gate[] like the ones that destroyed the Empire, and only you can prevent it.
Wh... What are you saying? Destroying the world? Why would anyone want to destroy the world? I can't believe that.

This is not their world, ignorant fool. Forsaken Ones look human, but they are the last of an ancient, alien people: the Muud'ari. What you are telling me is, these Muud'ari actually destroyed the Empire... And they didn't even care, they were just trying to return to their world? What kind of monsters are they?
How can I stop them?

Sister??? I never knew much about my family, being a war orphan. Do I have a sister? This all is too much.
Tremadan didn't give me much knowledge about family matters, but I know there's two of you, and she received a magical letter just like you did. Strange that she didn't arrive yet.
Uh oh. Amarisa!!! the girl who saved me from the cell, must also be my sister then. And they have her! I have to save her.
I see. That's twice unfortunate: they have the girl, and also the blood they need. This forces you to go out and seek them out. At least we can count on them keeping her alive.
I was looking for her anyways, now even more so. But Tremadan, being such a powerful wizard, surely located where the Forsaken are hiding, right?
Sadly, no. The Forsaken blocked his divination magic. Unbelievable, but true.
Wait... How? Blocked? Just like that?
Disappointing. Wasn't my grandfather an actual arch-mage?
"No other wizard in a centuries has been as powerful as Tremadan was; yet some power even greater than him is cloaking the Forsaken's hideout."
That's just... Great. If Tremadan couldn't find them in years, with all his magic and influence, what am I supposed to do now? is all hope lost?
There is a way, if legends hold true. But rest now and take posession of this place. Then meet me upstairs when you want to know more.

Obviously I have the good parts, and you the useless ones.

Well, I am the one holding the knowledge that can save your sister, and the whole world. So I disagree.
Underestimating you? That would be too difficult. I would be really surprised if you succeeded at locating the Forsaken.
Damn ghost or whatever you are, is there really a way to find Amarisa and the Forsaken?

That sounds... Extremely powerful. Any man owning that, could rule the world.

How many shards do I need to recover?

The Shards themselves are shielded from any possible divination. But they call for power. The most powerful monsters or individuals might have them. And the factions that are trying to find them, might possess one or several shards already.
Very well. I understand. Do I bring you the shards when I find them?
Oh yes, please, so I can grab them with my nonexistant hands. Please, use your brain! Tremadan set a special mirror frame, right here. When you find any of the shards, put it in place.
I see, you are a bit 'touchy' on the subject of being immaterial.

I wonder if my real grandfather was this bitter and moody as well. Will I become like that when I grow old?
By all means, have fun and mock an illusionary construct. Tells a lot about how much of an adult you are.

Manifesting like this consumes a lot of my magical energy. I will disappear for a while, but I might come back in the future. Try not to act too dumb, if you can avoid it.
I wouldn't be too worried about that if I was you...
By the Three, ain't you a nice phantom. Will you stay around, then?

Of course, to protect you all. He knew the Forsaken would look for the blood required to activate the Gate. He was ready to spend the rest of his life here in a tower, but he thought, it would be better for others to just stay away from all the risk, ignoring their own origin. It's not like your presence here makes any difference. I do all the work, you just complain.

He'll be the one focused on the Opening ritual, but he might send others for that task, so stay alert.
So... 'well done'. I guess, coming from you, it's a real compliment.
Is it alright to use this power? I mean, we're talking about... Tol.
Very well, go ahead and try to use it to locate the Forsaken.
Normally I'd snicker and say something about how the cute little adventurer wants a medal, but I admit I am impressed by what you did.
"That's a clever thing to ask. Yes, this is safe. In fact, Tol is not strictly a 'God'. His story is one you might want to unveil one day,and that of his companions; but now we have business to do."

"The power of this artifact is not easy to wield, and will cost all of my energy; it might dispell me permanently. As I gaze into the mirror, I'll speak what I see. If we never meet again, good luck with your quest."
I hope not. This tower won't be the same without and old cranky ghost.
You're not even my real grandfather, just some spell, so who cares.
I am not your grandfather, but I know him, and he'd be proud of you now. [BLUE](He looks into the mirror)[] I see a dark valley and fires on the mountain tops... A sea of mud and blood swirls below.

I see a copper dome floating in the lava... Yes, it is the wreck of the Ancient Ark of Lothasan! A vessel built by the Muud'ari ancestors. The Magister must have found it, and that's where they hide. No wonder a mere Archmage couldn't locate it!
Where is it? Where?

"I can't... I can't... [BLUE](The whole tower begins to vibrate, and suddenly the mirror surface explodes in blue flames. Tremadan's Image raises both his hands, and a magical barrier protects you from the magical energy. After the wave passes, you see the mirror frame is empty; the Eye of Tol is no more."
So... We did it? Do we know where to find them?

Yes and no. I saw the place but it didn't look familiar to me. Yet I am sure some research will tell me where that flaming valley lies. I consumed all my energy, but I'll be back soon and I'll find the location for you.
My mission is done, now it's all in your hands. Either the Past will devour the Present, or a new Future will be born.

I found it! Yes, what we saw in the Eye matches some ancient maps. The wrecked Ark of Lothasan must be in the Ashen Cape. It is the southernmost point of Varannar, past the Ashen Wastes. Not an easy place to reach, much less to survive.
What are you still doing here? You should be finding your way to the Ashen Cape.
Ah, it is you. I am still trying to locate that valley I saw on the Eye of Tol. Keep preparing yourself, I'll send you a message when I find the place.
Good. I'll keep getting stronger, and I'll return when I get your message.
I want to ask you about something.
What can you tell me about the Ashen Cape and how to get there?
What can you tell me about the Ashen Cape and how to get there?
I am busy, please be quick. What do you want to know?
You mentioned the 'Ark of Lothasan'. I never heard that name before.
Why the Forsaken won't just stay here? Haven't they lived peacefully here for centuries?
Nothing, sorry for the interruption.
Let me ask you something else.

The most ancient myth of the Muud'ari. Lothasan was a wise ruler who built an enchanted ship, largest than any Imperial Galley you can imagine. It could not only sail the seas, but also travel between worlds, and that is how Muud'ari arrived. However the vessel crashed and they were forced to remain here.

Generations of Muud'ari lived and died among humans as equals, even mixing with them in some cases. Some kept practicing their ancient customs and rites, but many others even forgot their lineage or chose not to tell their children.  All this changed 200 years ago.
What happened?
Nevermind, I'm not in the mood for a long story now.

"Ancient lore from the Days of the Arrival was found. And it revealed that Muud'ari were immortal creatures when they lived in their world, Noutamet. They would never age nor become sick; they'd even heal from most wounds.  But here, they were mere mortals."
Wow. Do you think that 'ancient lore' was accurate?

I believe it, yes, but maybe it's not the whole story. However the idea of immortality is the ultimate seduction. They obsessed over returning to their homeworld,  and they despised this 'World of Decay' which now became the source of all their sorrows. And they now saw humans as inferiors.
I begin seeing the picture now. What happened next?

They called themselves the Forsaken now, and put all their resources to work toward one goal: returning to Noutamet. Keep in mind these people were dukes, court wizards, high priests... Decade after decade they worked, until a century ago. A young Muud'ari wizard found the way.
Let me guess, the Deep Gates.

Indeed. An immensely costly ritual that can open a tear on the fabric of reality itself, allowing travel between worlds and dimensions. The rest of what happened, along with the Empire and millions of lives lost, is history.
I see. These guys are really going to do it. I must stop them.
I can't help but wonder, if in their place I'd also do the same.
Well said. Now let me work, so I might find the location fo the last Deep Gate.
[BLUE](He looks at you intently, as caresses his beard)[] Well, you are not on their place, actually you are in their way. Now let me work and go away.

There is some very powerful magical distortion at work there, which over the centuries has turned the place into an unhinabitable hell. All attempts to explore it failed, and the information we have is scarce and contradictory. Some tales mention ghostly lights that scorch flesh and boil blood.

And even getting there can prove to be a challenge. The seas are fierce, which would explain why it's the the Ark's wrecking place. There are no recorded land routes, and teleportation is out of the question. Maybe you can find a way through the mountains, it's the only possibility.
The way you put it, we've pretty much failed. Sounds like a place that can't be reached, or even survived.

However, the Forsaken are able to travel there when they need to. There must be ways to overcome the dangers, and I'll find them. The first step will be moving to Friguld, maybe I can find a ship that'll take me south.
"Don't give up, young one; there is always a way. If the Forsaken can travel there, so can you. "
You might not be entirely braindead after all. Well said, now go and stop them, whatever the cost is.
My duty is done, and I'll leave this world for good. If you succeed, humanity is going to set itself free of the dark past, a past Tremadan was part of. It's better to forget and simply look forward.
Wait a minute... Are you leaving forever? I still have questions for you.
I will take care of this.
I was summoned by Tremadan to do a very specific task, and that task is done. You know all you need to know to fulfill your quest.
I think you are hiding things from me.
Yes, for your own good. And now it's time for you to go.
Someone has told me that you lied to me about the Deep Gate ritual. Something is amiss here, and I'm not going to do anything until you tell me the truth.
Grrr... Fine. I'll have to find out by myself.
You will not provide answers? Very well, maybe the Magister can provide them instead. I'll try to talk to him.
The story you told me has too many holes. Obviously There is some connection between Tremadan and the Gates. I am not sure I should do your bidding, if the information I have is false.

I see. [BLUE](The phantasmal image suddenly looks weary)[]. It is true that the Deep Gate ritual needs Tremadan's blood as an ingredient like I said... but not because he was an Archmage, but because he, Tremadan... I... I created the Deep Gate ritual two centuries ago. Foolishly I did, for I brought ruin upon this world.
What? Why would you do that? ... Oh, wait... Don't you tell me...

Yes. Deep down you always knew the truth, didn't you? Your mind can't be controlled, and you are stronger, faster, more intelligent than humans. I wish you had never found out, but since you did you might as well know it all. Your grandfather was the leader of the Deep Lords, the sorcerers that opened the Gates.
This is too much. Why have you been lying to me? Was Tremadan an evil monster? Is this part of his scheme?

"No, everything I said is true. The days before the Deep Gates would be opened, he began suspecting something terrible could come out of the Gate, threatening humanity. He warned the other Deep Lords, but all they cared about was reaching Noutamet and achieving immortality; they didn't hesitate and opened their gates through the Empire, bringing the apocalypse. But Tremadan couldn't: he destroyed his Gate instead."

That's why the Isle of Varannar was saved, but the Muud'ari that remained here vowed to hunt down the traitor and obtain his blood to open a Deep Gate again. Thus the Order of the Forsaken was born. Tremadan's assistant had the knowledge to complete the ritual, and became the Magister of the order.
If he repented, I don't see the reason to hide this tale from me and from Amarisa.
The knowledge of what you are doesn't change anything about your quest, true, but...
... But now I know that instead of confronting the Forsaken, I could join them and cross the Deep Gate to Noutamet, becoming immortal.

I hope you will not make that mistake. Even if you didn't care about the world around you, there is no knowledge about why our ancestors came here. Maybe they were escaping a dying world... And there's no telling how you would be received by your bethren.
Yet the Deep Lords, wise as they were, were ready to take the risks.

We were nothing but fools. This is your world, the one where we all were born, loved, suffered, aged. Forget Noutamet, don't let that foolish dream of immortality poison your mind, like it once poisoned mine.
[BLUE](The gentle thuramian lady makes a curtsey )[] I am Arabelle, from Solliga. Pleased to meet you.
I want to join the Wizard's Guild. Can you help me?
Do you offer training?
Nevermind, goodbye.

I don't think so, youngster. The Wizard's Guild raises its own apprentices. We're not a bunch of rogues or mercenaries hungry for young blood, like the other guilds. Yet if you believe yourself to be that useful to our Guild, feel free to visit the College of Magic in Icemist.
How can I get to the town of Icemist?

"More than a town, Icemist is a magical fortress. Very few are allowed in. Try to gain as much reputation as possible by helping the guild members in all four Enclaves; with their recommendation, you might be allowed to enter."

I sometimes instruct apprentices, yes. Nothing as fancy as what you can learn at Icemist but still useful. However, I won't train someone that is a complete stranger and hasn't earned the trust of our Guild. [BLUE](You need a reputation of at least 7 with the Wizard's Guild)[]
I sometimes instruct apprentices, yes. Nothing as fancy as what you can learn at Icemist but still useful. However, I charge as much as the Guild does. Interested?

I am a specialist in the powers of the Plane of Ice.  By learning [BLUE]Ice Mastery[] you'll be able to bring fire elementals to your aid. It can also be wise to learn [BLUE]Ice Ward[] because many times you'll confront blizards that are not under your control.

Welcome again.No progress, I see... Please understand recovering Terezza's research notes is an urgent matter.
Welcome to the Great Plains Enclave of the Wizard's Guild. You are not a member of our guild, so this hall is the only part of the tower in which you will be allowed.

Teleportation, purchase of magical ingredients, item crafting, enchanting, advice and research... You name it. Just make sure you have the gold for it.
I am afraid not, maybe in a few weeks, when we receive new goods from Icemist.
Yes, I could use some help, but I need someone already trusted by the guild for such a sensible matter. [BLUE](You need a reputation of 7 or more with the Wizard's Guild)[]

Yes, I could use some help and you're well known for your services to the guild. I don't know why, but everybody is full of prejudices about us Thuramians. They accuse us of whatever unfortunate disasters fall upon them!

... Unfortunate disasters? Such as?
For instance, in New Anthur they claim we have something to do with their poisonous river. And here in Ilmara, they accuse us of their problem with [BLUE]Vorators[]. Pure prejudice, I tell you!
Vorators? I think those are some real dangerous beasts from the Thyr Mountains. What's the deal with them?

It is well known, gems are very rare in Ilmara. The reason is those nasty burrower beasts, the Vorators. They appeared 20 years ago, always digging tunnels by devouring rocks with their bluesteel teeth. Nothing stops them! And gems are their favorite meal.
I bet mining with such beasts around is dangerous, tough luck for Ilmarans. But what is the job about?

I recently discovered that 20 years ago, a guild wizard called Terezza began her research north of here, in some laboratory in the Thyr Ridges. It was about... Well, efficient ways to dig rocks using magical beasts. The guild never heard about her again.

[BLUE](Coughs)[] Well, well... That'd be jumping to early conclusions. What is essential now is that someone locates her laboratory notes about Vorators, so they can be studied properly at Icemist. Maybe they can come up with a solution.

This sounds extremely dangerous, those beasts should be dealt with by the guild directly. Goodbye.
That's great news. Just remember, those beasts will devour anything, be it rocks, steel, trash... Or adventurers. I'm ready to pay good gold to cover the risks.

Ilmarans definitely have very poor safety regulations. It's all their fault, if you ask me.

Hello, I am just an adventurer. I wonder if there're any treasures around.
I am the golem repairman. Please detach your own head and sit down.
[BLUE](You remember the name on the book you found)[] I am a guest of Terezza.

I am the pineapple man!
I was just looking for the bathroom, sorry, I'll be on my way.
