Identification failed. Please stay still while you are removed using manual procedure.
Identification failed. Automatic removal activated! [BLUE](A bolt of energy is projected towards you, blasting you with a powerful shock)[]
An interesting rune... Probably magical, and seems to be active.
Oh, this is a levitation rune, relatively common. I think I know the incantation to activate it and float upstairs.
I'd rather not touch this, just in case.
Do you want to activate the rune now?
Yes, activate the rune and return to Thyr Ridges.
No, I'll stay here a little longer.

This sign is very old, but still legible. 'Thanks for your visit. Remember the cave is sealed from teleportation. To return to Thuram please use this emergency exit, or levitate using the main entrance'.
That's a strange notice...
The ancient stairs have collapsed after a few steps. Past the darkness you see the reflection of a polished stone floor below. It is hard to estimate the distance, though.
Descend as much as you can, then jump down, hoping the fall is short.
Ignore the stairs.
With your keen eyes, notice some holds on a side wall to descend most of the distance, then make a short jump down.
Down in the distance you think you recognize a rune; someone created a levitation enchantment in this place... Recite a well-known cantrip that should activate it, and then jump down.
The fall is longer than expected, and the impact against the cold ground is brutal... Maybe even lethal.
You descend several yards and then hop down to the ground. The fall is still painful, but not as deadly.
"You float down nicely, it works! Unfortunately, the enchantment is old and after some time, you begin to fall; luckily there's not much distance to the ground."
Ouch!

Freedom, traveller. [BLUE](the officier salutes you martially, fist to his chest)[]. Did you come through the Jabal pass, to the north? If you have seen anything unusual in the hills, I'd like to hear about it.
There is still spiders around, fight first, talk later!
That was a hard fight, and your help was more than welcome. At this rate, however, things are going to end up badly. Spiders coordinating an attack... In 50 years I never saw anything like this.
Have you found anything about the grotto in the hills, or the spiders?

I don't know what you did deep into the hills, but the spiders are fleeing back to the deep caves, and acting normally. I wish I could reward you properly, but I'm afraid all of this has been unofficial business. At least, I'll give you my best healing potion.
Nothing to report as of late, adventurer.
Unusual? Like what?
Well, the giant spiders obviously, as there's never been as many as now. But also, any caves, or maybe people deep into the hills, because...
What I wonder is, why the Mercian Legions don't go in force and solve this issue?

Every other kingdom is plotting to overthrow us... Our beloved King has his hands full. Still, a month ago he sent an elite squad from the Third Legion to help us. Twenty veteran scouts, with the mission to investigate the cave where the spiders originate. But it was a disaster.
They never returned? This sounds bad.

Only one did: Decurion Sargos. His face and body scarred beyond recognition by the poison, one eye lost, and his mind completely gone. He just mumbled to himself like a madman, and then he left. We never heard what was of the rest.
So... What is going on here? And what are you going to do?
There is little I can do with my scarce men, and my orders to defend this position. But maybe someone else could look into this.
Is this the part when you ask me to go to the place where twenty elite legionnaires were horribly slaughtered?
Maybe I could go deep into the hills and investigate.
I think all of this is beyond my abilities.
I know this is dangerous, indeed. But my instinct tells me, if nothing is done, something terrible will happen. Anything you can find out about this may help.
Centurion! A spider swarm is coming! They are... Attacking our position!
From the north too, this is insane! They're too many, we can't hold them!
You will contain them, dogs, or you'll have to face me instead of the spiders! For Mercia, you'll crush them! Traveller, help us if you can.
I am afraid, I've found the corpses of the scouts. However, there's a magical barrier I can't cross.
Nothing yet.
They died serving their kingdom, like true heroes. Well, I really have no idea about magical barriers and such. I hope you can find a way through.
Thanks. Have you maybe seen Decurion Sargos?
Yes, and I was so glad to see such a hero back. He headed back to Freetown.
This magical barrier of energy seems to be indestructible... At the other side, you see several corpses, almost devored to the bones. That's all that remains of the Third Legion elite scouts.
This magical barrier of energy seems to be indestructible...
It is impossible to even make a dent on this thing...
Put your magical keystone in contact with the barrier.
There is a flash of turquoise light, and both gem and barrier dissolve into nothingness.
[BLUE](A group of well armed men comes out of their hiding spots. Their leader points his sword, ordering the bandits to attack)[] Attack, men! That is the woman that carries the gems and gold!
Go in... You must end this for me...
I am here. Here. Finally, all the time inside, all will end...
Um... Sure. Just do something to open the barrier.
Are those corpses there what remains of your men?
Yes, yes, I promised. Fifty. I will open the barrier. [BLUE](The man places a hand inside a pocket, and some blue light gleams out. The barrier suddenly vanishes!)[]
[BLUE](His still functional eye passes over the corpses, then fixates back on you)[] Good men. Good men. They served well. Now, I open the barrier and you go inside. Must be fifty.
Let's not waste time. Open the barrier.
Wait a minute... You don't even care about your lost friends. I can't trust you. Give me that magical key, and begone.
One moment, I have something else to do first.
I just realized... your men couldn't get out, yet you did. How can I trust you to keep the barrier open for me? I want to see that key you have and how it works.
No! It must be fifty! Fifty! [BLUE](The gleam of madness in his eyes intensifies as he leaps upon you like a beast. He attacks you with unnatural might and speed)[]
[BLUE](He looks suddenly confused, anxious)[] Trust me! Go inside!
Show me that key first, or I'll just walk away from this.
Very well, I will trust you. Open the barrier.
No! Don't leave. Look, this is it. This will open the barrier! [BLUE](He pulls out a blue gemstone, and shows it to you. He looks immensely distressed)[]
Very well, I will trust you. Open the barrier.
Hmmm a magical keystone... If it is destroyed, the barrier will be gone forever. [BLUE](Slap the gem out of his hand, then try to crush it)[]

[BLUE](Skillfully, you make the gem fall, then stomp it with your heel. Before Sargos can react, the gem is shattered, and the blue barrier dissolves into nothingness....)[] Noooo! the Lady will never free me now! I promised her fifty men! Fifty hosts, and only one remained to be free!
What in the name of The Three are you saying...
[BLUE](The man screams and runs away before you can react... But you notice something horrifying. A small white spider, moving inside his ear.)[]

Now I will finally be FREE!!!! Lady... Lady I have brought you the last of the fifty victims I promised. Hosts for your spider eggs [BLUE](The large man raises the gem again and suddenly the barrier reappears. You are trapped!)[]
Bastard... Traitor... I am going to get out of here and track you down.
Wait Sargos... You don't have to do this! I am on your side, let's talk...
[BLUE](A disembodied woman voice echoes, with terrible resonance, saying 'YOU ARE FREE'. And then a disgusting white spider crawls out of Sargos' ear. The man laughs and runs away)[]
Great... So he betrayed his own men first, then many others and finally me.
North: Jabal Pass. West:  FreeTown. East: Sydarun

Finally... The monster has come. The bloodthirsty creature that dares to challenge my power. Well, your journey ends here. You will never stop me, nor will you recover the shard.[BLUE] (This woman's power can be felt even at a distance. She casually waves a hand, and a blue energy barrier forms behind you)[]
Wait,we don't have to fight. All I want is to get out of here. I am no enemy of the Varannari, and I know nothing about any shard!
Oh, a sorceress. A fine challenge. Let's do this.
You dare to call me bloodthirsty monster? You plant spiders in people's brains, madwoman.
[BLUE](Try to make her talk more)[] Let's talk about that shard.

Oh, we don't have to fight? You think you are talking to one of those stupid impiri out there... I know perfectly well what will happen if you get all the shards: your people almost destroyed the world once, and is now trying to do it again. There's no possible negotiation between us, monster.
Very well. I have no idea what you talk about, but I'm here to stop you anyways.
Come to your death, but know that I will not fight alone...
What do you mean?
I summon you, Tyogos, guardian of the Flame! [BLUE](A magical portal opens and  a druid appears besides her)[]
I summon you, Tyogos, guardian of the Flame! [BLUE](A magical portal opens... But it flickers and disappears.)[] What? Tyogos is dead? It doesn't matter. You'll be destroyed.
Damnit, this is not fair...
Heh, are things not going according to plan, sorceress?
I summon you, Surtag, swordmaster of my people! [BLUE](A magical portal opens and a mighty warrior appears besides her)[]

I summon you, Surtag, swordmaster of my people! [BLUE](A magical portal opens... But it flickers and disappears. You see doubt in the woman's expression)[] Impossible... You killed my swordmaster? A thousand deaths are not enough punishment for you, monster.
Uh... This doesn't look good.
[BLUE](Chuckle)[] I think you're not going to see your warrior until you dive into hell, witch.

Are you trying to make me talk? But why not... you will die here and now, after all. Know that with all my powers, I was only able to locate one shard. I am researching ways to destroy it, so you can never again bring ruin to our world.
[BLUE](Keep bluffing)[] Why do you think I would like to destroy the world? That's silly. Think about it.

Let's keep talking... Maybe we can find a compromise. Fighting is pointless.

Deep Lord..?!? The Deep Lords that destroyed the Empire? Are you insane? I am just an adventurer!
I will say no more. You'll now know the power of the Old Ways, and succumb.
You are a murderer... As is all of your people. You, Impiri, will be pushed back to the sea where you came from, when every beast in our land raises against you!
A pity that you won't be there to see it happen.
Wait wait... You don't really believe a few coyotes and mirmeks can threaten the Exiled Kingdoms, do you?
You are a fool. I am a humble servant of Lady Xydar. She is already raising a vast horde of giant spiders in the Jabal Hills, which will poison and devour all the arrogant impiri like you.
Well done, now I can prepare all the potions and defenses that the Garrison needs. Thanks, in the name of The Three.
Welcome again. Remember I still wait for those [BLUE]12 skulls[].

I require healing

Can I be of service to The Three?
I can heal you, in exchange of a small contribution to our Shrine.
Here is a small donation. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 25 gold coins, be healed for 25hp)[]
I wish to make a large donation then. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 60 gold coins, be healed for 80hp)[]
Not at the moment thanks. I better be on my way.
By the Power of Arbenos, Thelume and Nivaria, be healed of your wounds!
[BLUE](the man smiles )[] But of course. Just stop me if I go long winded, will you? And if you need to learn more about the Faith, visit the High Temple in Nivarian.
The city of Nivarian takes its name from the Goddess Nivaria, right? Is She there now?
We're in Ilmara, I know here religion is above all. Then why are you here in a small Shrine, instead of having built a temple?

Correct, She herself built the city with her powers, for the Colonists had lost everything and were without shelter, hungry and despaired. She is the Merciful Mother, and the true founder of the Kingdom, as she was our first Holy Queen. But she is no longer with us, legend says she sleeps under the Lake Nivar.
She was the first Queen of Ilmara? And why did she go to sleep under the lake?

A truly sad story. She fell in love with Xoladan the Just, the ruler of the Colonists that founded the Kingdom. After the Witches of Orogg were defeated, they ruled together and made our Kingdom strong and prosperous. But Xoladan grew old and passed away, and that filled Nivaria with a deep sorrow.
Since then, who rules in the Kingdom of Ilmara?
This is fascinating but I really must be going.

The Xoladan dinasty, of course. The king and queen were lost, but they left three children. And today, the great-granddaughter of Xoladan and Nivaria, Queen Simarie, sits on the Azure Throne, with divine blood running through her veins. May she be blessed by The Three.
Answer another question for me, please.
Thanks. Enough teachings for now. I must be going.
What else do you want to know?

[BLUE](The man chuckles)[] A fair question. We priests are to remain humble, and in the service of our people. Thelume the Wise, one of the Three, instructed our Queen not to build temples, except in large cities that can actually need them.

There are of course many cults, including the old Imperial Religion. But we the Priests of The Three are the only ones that have divine powers. We can heal the injured, or destroy the undead. That's why most people in the Kingdoms pray to The Three now.

Yes. These are indeed dark times, as the undead grow restless and crawl out of the Tolassian tombs. I have been asked by the Captain to prepare some defenses, but I require an ingredient which I don't possess. The skulls of animated skeletons.
Where can I find them?
I don't want to have anything to do with skeletons, thanks.

Sadly, in too many places. If you go south to the Deadwood, you'll find undead, but that's dangerous. You may prefer to explore some Tolassian tombs in the other side of the river. Of course, I will reward you. I can give you a shield that can ward you from Death Magic. At least in part.
Very well, I'll try to do it.
I will await your return. Bring me [BLUE]12 Skulls[] and that'll be enough.
You took such a long time! I am glad to be able to leave this stinking town and return home.
You took such a long time! I am glad to be able to leave this stinking town and return home.
This waiting is insufferable. What is taking so long? Just go and hunt down those stupid beasts.
Did you change your mind? Want to hunt down Minotaurs for me?
[BLUE](The man dresses as a Varsilian noble, and speaks to you uneasily)[] Hey you, commoner! Are you an adventurer for hire?
I am a person with manners, unlike you. Goodbye.
Yes, are you in need of assistance?

[BLUE](The man shakes his head in disgust, then turns his attention to other travellers)[]
Hmph. Very well. Pleased to meet you. Can we now discuss business?
Sadly, I am busy with something right now. But I might return.
Yes, go ahead and tell me what do you need.

I am Sir Therod Nom, from New Garand. I was in a heated discussion with Sir Nellas Gissar, about which of our families has the most heroic legacy. Of course, everyone knows about the Nom heroes, back in the Empire.
I never heard the name. And no, that's not an invitation to tell me about your ancestors.
Heated discussion? Please, tell me you didn't murder him and that's why you had to flee the town and the Kingdom.

Let's just go to the point. In order to make clear I was the most heroic, I made a bet. I would return to the town after fighting Minotaurs, and bring one of their horns. Then he'd have to admit my family is above his.
That sounds a bit... unwise. Minotaurs are dangerous. Although you must be tougher than you look, if you have traveled alone from New Garand to here.

That's right, I am tough! That damn boatman was rude and smelled like rot. And this... Town, is so disgusting. Plus I've heard there's coyotes out there. I am very heroic, but obviously a man like me shouldn't risk his own life.
Yeah, sure. So of course you want someone like me to do it instead. But I don't see why I should.
"I am really tired of your ""superiority"". Good luck with the Minos, big hero."
Well, as I have gained some weight, my [BLUE]Lionskin cuirass[] feels a little tight. I might as well give it to you in exchange for a [BLUE]Minotaur horn[]. Deal?
Very well, I'll do it.
No. You made a bet, you do the job or you lose. That's how it works.
Good, good. I came here to Rhöneis because I have heard there are Minotaurs near Jabal, to the west. I'll await your return here.
Bah, commoners. If you change your mind, come find me here.
East: Nivarian.  South: Rhöneis.  West: Fögas.
There is something odd about this wall. Probably it was very well camouflaged years ago, but erosion shows how it's been made of different stones and manipulated often.
Adaon, check this wall for me!
Is that block sticking out slightly...? [BLUE](Press it)[]
Damnit... I have no time to examine walls now.
[BLUE](Coughs heavily)[] Really, are you going to ground me facing the wall now? Wait.. Look, that loose brick is suspicious!
Good job! [BLUE](Press it)[]
When you press it, gas stops hissing into the room, and the iron grates slowly withdraw.

[BLUE](Azeran is surrounded in a bright magical aura as he performs a ritual over the opened sarcophagus. He turns to face you angrily, and you realize he doesn't seem to be the same person... he doesn't even seem human anymore)[] No! No interruptions now! This power... this knowledge... I still can't control it! I still don't understand it! Noooooo!
Stop whatever you're doing, you bastard!
It's fine, I can come back later if you want...

[BLUE](Azeran screams in pain, and for an instant the walls and ceiling around you seem to twist in agony... You don't understand the kind of power being released out of that sarcophagus, but it's like nothing you've ever experienced)[] I was so close... so close! I can't control it! ... Noooo!

"[BLUE](It seems as if Azeran's body is being torn to pieces as he screams... And it happens before your eyes: there's now several Azeran in front of you looking at each other in sheer terror. One of them quickly teleports away; the others attack you wildly )[] We can't endure this pain! Free us!"

A shimmering blue barrier blocks this ancient magic gate.
Take your [BLUE]Purple Medallion[] and raise it in front of the barrier while you recite the Prayer you learned in the City of the Ancients.
Walk through the gate

"The blue barrier is strong as an iron wall; no matter what you try, you can't go through it."
At least I wasn't zapped this time.

Alright, no reason to get nervous. We leave.
We come in peace and maybe we can work together.
Filthy son of a lizard, you're going to regret coming to this valley.
Loot? Gate? That sounds interesting.
Did I say 'leave'? Sorry, what I mean is, give us all your gold and gems, then you can leave.
Come and take it if you can, scaly.
Very well, I agree. Everything for peace and friendship.
Really? I was just trying to pick a fight, you know, but you mammals have no self-respect. You are literally suckers since you are born, so I shouldn't be surprised.

"So that's why you are here, you also heard of the treasures of the Silent Kings. We've travelled long, even crossed the seas to plunder this place; we will not share with anyone, nor need the help of pathetic mammals to find beloved gold and gems. You had never seen such an ancient codex... This was written many centuries ago in elegant imperial calligraphy. Unfortunately the book has been chewed and clawed, so you can understand very little of it.
Try to find some legible pages.
I'm not in the mood for reading.

One page says '... But our prayers are unheard: the Gods remain asleep. Generations pass, our numbers dwindle and our magic weakens. Yet we need to remain strong to protect our Masters' slumber! Potions of longevity are not meant to be used more than once in a lifetime, yet we have no choice if we want to prevent...'
Try to find another intact page.
Enough for now.

The next page you find seems to have been written by the same hand... Despite being clearly many centuries later. 'THIEVES and MURDERERS. LOOTERS and BANDITS. They entered our sacred temple, they stole the treasures of four of the Sleepers, KILLED our BROTHERS and SISTERS... and worse of all, four of the Sleepers are no more. We don't understand...'
This SACRILEGE must be punished. Four of the Five are no more, so many generations of worship and love, gone. Four adventurers, we will find them... We will... EAT THEM. We will REND THEIR FLESH'

It goes on, the elegant writing now replaced by crude scribbling: 'But NO, we still protect the Fifth Sleeper, Lord Absalos. We REMAIN. We ENDURE. We have changed... We are barely human anymore, but we do what must be done'.
Try to find another passage.
The rest of the book is filled with mindless scribbling, as if the one writing it had lost his mind gradually.
Temple of the Sleepers. If you are a Tomb Robber or the like, you better leave while you still have legs.
Still here? Hey, we understand. You have little Looters at home you need to feed. But the only thing you're going to feed is the worms, unless you turn around.
You passed the pit! Not many thieves reach this far. Unfortunately you can't go back anymore, and there's no way you can survive what lies ahead. Enjoy your final (And very painful) minutes of life.

"I know what you're thinking... Elemental hazards, not very original. But bear with us, we had a huge dungeon to fill! However this is the end of the line for you; there's simply no way for you to survive our teleportation maze!"
"You reached the Sanctum of the Sleeper... unbelievable. We now pray that He awakes to smite you with his Divine Wrath!"
No matter what you try, the lid does not move. You suspect the Sleeper does not wish to be disturbed.
Maybe this can be inspected after you have dealt with Azeran!

"Inside the sarcophagus lies a plain-looking young man. A wicked ritual knife is stuck in his chest; probably the doing of Azeran. Despite this, there is no blood and you believe the man is alive although there's an expression of pain in his face."
Try to help him by removing the knife.
Kill the man.
I need a moment...

"The evil weapon is cold to the touch. You raise it carefully... And to your surprise no blood pours out. Once you remove it from the young man's body,no wound or scar remains. The young man's face is now filled with peace and a sudden fragant wind runs through the chamber; a feeling of fulfillment and gratitude from the Sleeper overcomes you."
"You understand the Sleeper is urging you to leave now; the stone lid of the Sarcophagus flies by itself and covers it with a dull thud."
The Sleeper's eyes suddenly open, and you freeze. You see pain in his eyes, but his pain is nothing compared to yours when his mere gaze consumes you to ashes.
Ancient carvings on this monolith have been adorned over the centuries by Varannari paintings. It's obvious this stone bears some significance for the natives
No way I'm touching this.
Let's see what happens if I touch this...
Nothing happens. If there was magic inside this stone, it probably faded a long time ago.
As soon as you touch it, you feel as if you were falling through a very long tunnel...
You seem to be at a different place!
"You stand in front of a strange Sarcophagus. It was once inscribed with many magical runes and furnished with gems, silver and gold; it has obviously been looted long ago."
Raise the lid and look inside.
It's better to leave this alone.
Unfortunately the looters had little respect for whoever rested here. All you can find is dust and small fragments of bone, half-covered by rotten rags.
Let's travel swiftly. I won't rest easy until I leave the savage lands behind me. Remember, just following the road west will take us there.
Finally, I am safe in civilized Mercian soil. You earned your reward of [BLUE]500 gold[].
Greetings, foreigner. You seem to be well armed... Are you available for bodyguard work? I offer [BLUE]500 coins[] for a short trip west.
That's a fine sum, no doubt. But where exactly west?
Not right now, thanks. I'm busy with other tasks, but I might return another time.

My final destination is Freetown. But I only need escort until the [BLUE]guard post in Southern Jabal Hills[]. From there, the road is safe. It is easy to find, following the west road. We have to border the Trollfens, but I doubt we'll run into trolls if we follow the road.
Agreed. I'll make sure you get there safely. Follow me.
Not right now, thanks. I'm busy with other tasks, but I might return another time.
Very well. We'll be in that guard post in Southern Jabal in no time.
I don't think that payment is fair at all. The dangers have been bigger than you led me to believe. You expected to be attacked on the road.
Very well, thanks and have a safe trip!
A deal is a deal. It is true that I carry valuable gems, and expected to be attacked. But I never lied to you.
Very well, just pay me then, and let's split ways
As you wish. However, I will make known to everyone you're carrying a fortune in gems. Let's see if the road to Freetown is as safe as you believe.
Pay me a thousand now, or I'll take it from you.
Farewell!
Are you crazy? The guards are right there. Do that and your head will rest on a pike.
Very well, I accept the 500 coins.
[BLUE](Attack her)[]Now die, fool.
You win... Here is 800 coins but please be quiet!

Freedom, traveller. Welcome to the Oasis. I have to warn you, don't wander south of town, for we're suffering a Mirmek infestation. I am very concerned about our slaves' safety.
We are free of those horrible creatures. I can hardly believe it. Here is your reward.
There's still disgusting vermin all around... Keep finding the source of those Mirmek.
Freedom, traveller. Welcome to the Oasis.
Thanks for the warning. Maybe I can help?
I will be careful, thanks.
Concerned about slaves? I thought mercians didn't care about them.

Many adventurers have tried to push them back, but they keep breeding, and we suspect they've nested into the mountain caves, somewhere. As a reward for getting rid of them, I can offer you a valuable [BLUE]magical ring[].
Why would you think that? Of course I care for them and I want them to be treated fairly. They're part of our Kingdom.
[BLUE](Smile with irony)[]Then why don't you set them all free? That's what they would want.
Sure, not really my business. So, tell me about that Mirmek problem.

[BLUE](the man chuckles)[] What they want, or what I want, is meaningless. Soldiers may not want go to war, peasants may not want to plow the fields. They're now part of the greatness of Mercia. We all do our duty, so the kingdom may be strong.
I disagree. I think slavery is always a mistake.
I see your point. Duty. It makes sense, some people is not smart enough to be free.
Humm... Sure. Well, I have to go.
But what about Varsilia? A mighty kingdom, yet they don't need slaves.
That's the size of it, really. It's better for everyone.
Well, you're a foreigner. What do you know. Just respect the law and believe what you want.
So, about those Mirmek...
I must go now
[BLUE](The man looks at you confused and shifts his weight uncomfortably)[] Um... Well... I don't really know... Let's talk about something else.
It's not the first time I deal with Mirmek nests. Very well, I'll do what I can.
I can't do it right now.
Can you offer me any advice about fighting them?
Well, they're rather vulnerable to poison, from what my men tell me.
Yes, I'll take care of it soon.
Can you offer me any advice about fighting them?
Well, they're rather vulnerable to poison, from what my men tell me.
My friend. Ruun remembers North now.
[BLUE](A very large Varannari with a metal collar salutes you)[] Foreign master has any gifts?
Get out of my way, scum.
Gifts? What do you mean?
Who are you?
Ruun misses North, misses the fight and hunting, falling snow, the wolves howling. Ruun wants gift from the north.
And why should I give anything to a slave? You own nothing to give back.
Are you allowed to beg like this, and to keep something like that?
Good, but I'm afraid I must go.
Actually... What about this wolf skin? Would it be enough of the North for you?
Yes foreign master. Ruun poor, can't give anything.
Uh... Ruun didn't... Goodbye.
Ruun wants! But ruun has nothing to pay.
It's fine. It's just a wolfskin, keep it.
Well, too bad then.
¡Ruun is masters' friend now.
[BLUE](The young woman, with a chain around her neck,  bows down to salute you)[]
Why are you chained? You don't look like a criminal.
What's this place? Odd location for a village.
Sorry, I am busy.
[BLUE](She looks down nervous at your question)[] I am a slave, my duty is to take care of the water supplies, sir.
A slave? But that's horrible, I will save you now!
Well, that explains the chain. So tell me what kind of village is this.
I must go.
Oh, then you are a criminal. I heard in Mercia they only enslave Varannari and convicts, and you are not green enough.
[BLUE](She keeps her work polishing the water barrels, ignoring your words)[]
There is a third possibility: my parents were slaves. Please let me keep at my work, I beg you.
The Oasis is not really a village, more like a military fort. Most of the people here are soldiers, or slaves that work in the quarry to the southeast.
The Fallen Heroes that died for the Empire. They will never return to Andoria, but the Empire will never forget their sacrifice.
Read more.
Enough reading.
[BLUE](The next pages are very damaged, and list hundreds of names. Likely a record of all the fallen soldiers buried here)[]
Leave.

In these halls lie the mortal remains of heroic Flaming Dragoons, sworn brothers under fire, blood and honor. A hundred of them resisted the advance of two thousand rebels, with unheard of heroism and sacrifice. Half of them gave their life for the Empire and rest in these halls.
This book holds the records of the Mausoleum Caretakers. It's heavily damaged and written in old Imperial. Maybe you can understand some passages.
Read it.
Leave.

"...strange events. The dead are restless; the natives say the place is accursed. The Imperial Theurgists have found out that in ancient times, a mystical being called Tol cursed the whole Varannar, making the death ever restless. It is unknown if..."
Find another legible fragment.
Enough reading.
... Safe now. The rituals daily performed by our Imperial theurgists have finally contained the curse, and the dead no longer trouble us. But if something...
Find another legible fragment.
Enough reading.

"... Nobody knows what is happening in Andoria, but tales are terrifying. Whole cities destroyed and thousands dead; no wonder the new Theurgists never came. Now the dead wake up and we can't stop them, but as our Oath commands, we must remain in the Mausoleum. May the Eleven..."

The Pit of Traitors. The oathbreakers that challenged the Andorian Empire were crushed like insects at the Battle of Greenwood, now called Deadwood. Here lay their cursed bones within no marked grave, may their souls be eternally punished by the Court of the Eleven.
Read more.
Enough reading.

After their defeat in battle, many rebels fled like cowards to Castle Bluerock, their last refuge. The heroic Imperial Legions pursued the villains and laid siege to the Traitor's Rock for two years. Thus ended the Ronean Rebellion, for the Glory of the Eternal Empire!
War. War never changes.
The niche behind this tombstone is open and empty.
Yeah... Not interested, at lest for a while.
Carefully put Sir Morfados' remains inside the niche.

A blinding flash of light forces you to protect your eyes. When you open them again, blinking, you see a ghostly form raising from the niche, and finally dissolving into nothingness. You are overcome with a feeling of peace.
To the Caretaker quarters and Shrine to the Eleven.
If only you convince a troll to put his head inside this...
No use for me...
Soak the club in the burning oil to improvise a torch.

The crowd had been cheering the trolls until now, just arguing among themselves about which one would eat you first. But as you raise the burning club, all the people begins to clap and howl in excitement.
This chest contains all your items.
This chest is empty.
Get all my equipment back.
Not yet.

The door leads to the streets of Freetown. You won't be allowed to return to this room. [RED]Make sure you have recovered all your items from the chest, including those laying on the ground because of a full inventory[].
I will remain here for a while.
Go out to the streets.
This grate remains locked until your enemies have been defeated!
This grate is no longer locked.
Time to leave the arena.
I'll remain here a little longer.
"The crowd is barely paying attention while you walk away. A slave gives you [BLUE]250 gold[] and then guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."
"The crowd is still clapping and cheering at you while you walk away. A slave gives you [BLUE]500 gold[] and then guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"The crowd has been shouting your name during the fight, and now cheer and salute your victory. A slave pays you [BLUE]750 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"Your fight is just one among many that take place today in the Great Arena, and the crowd barely paid attention. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]1000 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"You notice how many cheer as you are called winner. Many in the crowd exchange money, as the bets on you were heavy. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]1500 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"People has been chanting your name during the fight, and as you win the roar from the crowd is deafening. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]2000 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"By the faces of the crowd you notice most didn't expect you to win today. Five thousand people stand in a deafening ovation. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]2500 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"By the excitement of the crowd you can tell they will be singing your name in many taverns tonight. Now only the Champion can rival your glory. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]3500 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."

"The glory is yours. Your name will be inscribed in the stone pillars of the Arena, and remembered for many years in this town. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]5000 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."
"You are victorious as the Arena Champion. A young scribe pays you [BLUE]500 gold[] and guides you to a room with a chest; it contains all your belongings."
Freedom, my friend. Hey, those red boots you have there... They are just like the ones in my book! Would you give them to me, so I can study them?
Freedom, my friend. I am still researching ways to make armor pieces out of red drake scales. Maybe one day I'll master the technique.

[BLUE](The man looks at the red scales without hiding his excitement and admiration, but after examining them, he frowns)[]. Too rigid to make them into armor... At least until I find out how to soften them. But I can craft a shield or a buckler for you.
I'm glad to see you're still alive, even if you still don't have those scales. I guess, our generation won't be able to see again wonders such as Red Leather armor.
[BLUE](This crafter is not working on any piece currently, but reading a book with a red dragon illustration.)[] Freedom, traveller. [BLUE](He resumes his reading)[]
Thanks, goodbye.
Hello, that book looks interesting.
Indeed, it is. It talks about the Flaming Dragoons, an imperial elite order that set the battlefield aflame using burning oil, then walked themselves into the flames, unharmed.
You don't believe that, do you?

Actually, I do. They employed Red Leather armor, made of the skin of Red Drakes and Red Dragons. Yes, I know some people don't even believe the Empire existed, much less dragons, but I am an expert leatherworker and I believe this book is legitimate, it even describes the armor pieces in detail.
Really? Maybe I could try to hunt down some of those drakes and bring you their scales.
Sure, believe what you will, that won't make it true.

[BLUE](He looks at you weighing your words, then his eyes go down on the book again)[]. Well, things aren't that easy. This book is no crafting manual, so I am not sure I can actually make armor for you. But if you bring me [BLUE]5 Fire Drake scales[] I will do my best.
Very well, I will try! Any idea where to look for them?
Sadly, no. There's legends and songs around about such monsters, but I have never been out of this town myself. You'll have to find them by yourself, I am afraid. Assuming they still exist.
I want a Red Leather Shield, usable by Warriors and Clerics.
I want a Red Leather Buckler, usable by everyone.
Let me think about it, I'll be back.
[BLUE](the artisan begins working masterfully and smiles proudly when finished)[] Very well, here is your well-earned shield.
Sorry, but no. Maybe I'll find a spare pair.
Sure, here they are.
Thank you very much! Here is what gold I can spare. Maybe one day I'll find out how to craft the finest armor in the Kingdoms, thanks to you.
[BLUE](The boatman looks at you warily)[] Hello there. What do you want?
Nothing, goodbye.
I want transportation by boat.

Well, I guess I can take you downstream to [BLUE]Jabal for 250 gold[], in about 12 hours. But if you want to come back, it'll have to be on foot, only without any cargo I can hope to row against the Nekhar's currents.
Take me to Jabal, then.
Hmmm I am not sure, maybe I'll be back later.
Hello, my friend! I am now the queen's favorite cook, thanks to you.

[BLUE](The man looks at the apples, hardly believing his eyes)[]. I am saved! I know how to compensate you. Here, I don't need the juice for the cake, I will extract it into a bottle for you, condensed with some magic tricks I know. If you ever have more apples, I can do it again for you.
What will I do!? I am dead, DEAD you hear me!?
What will I do!? I am dead, DEAD you hear me!?
You are the noisiest dead I've met...
I am busy, my condolences.

"First it was White Wolf Icy Stew; It took me ages to find an adventurer willing to bring me the required meat. Then it was Wyvern Eggs Omelette! Luckily I have contacts in the Legion, and a dozen men brought me the prized eggs. But of course that capricious and whimsical woman didn't have enough..."
Okay, I have a world to save while you cook.
Who are you talking about? Who is asking you to cook all those dishes?
[BLUE](Looks down, frustrated)[] The new queen, of course. And what can I do? It is easy to lose your head around her.
Oh, she must be real pretty then.
I mean... Losing your head literally. She has everyone beheaded for the smallest slight. Unless I can present her a Golden Pie, I am a dead man. DEAD MAN!!! [BLUE](He sobs)[]
Calm down, don't start again. What is the problem? You seem to be able to gather anything. Just make the pie.
You don't understand. Golden Pies are made of three Golden Apples, but they don't really exist, it is just a legend, a fairytale from the Colonization days. I am DEAD!
I see. You are in trouble. If I ever find Golden Apples, I'll let you know.
If I've learned something recently, it's that legends are often more than mere legends. Tell me where those fairytales come from.
Don't panic. Trust me, I might be able to help you, and you have nothing to lose anymore. Tell me about those fairytales.
Old stories say they grew along the wild north shores of Lake Nivar. Of course the region is now mostly farms from those Ilmarans, so I can't believe Golden Apples can really exist anymore.
Can you prepare me another bottle of juice from those apples?
I am glad to see your head is still over your shoulders.
Can you cook me something with Vorator Eggs like this one?
Of course, give me three Golden Apples and I will turn them into a potion for you.
Of course, just bring me three Golden Apples and I will turn them into a potion for you. Right now you don't have them.
Deal! Do it.
No, thanks.
I am glad to help a friend.
"A wonderful ingredient! Give me three and I'll fry them with sliced Jabal Potatoes and Ilmaran onions; you'll taste the best Omelette the Kingdoms have ever seen."
Deal! Do it.
No, thanks.
I am glad to help a friend.
This door leads to the Grey Library. Above it hangs an emblem picturing a glowing golden hand.
Enter the building.
Stay here.
This door leads to the training grounds of the Warriors' Guild.
Enter the building.
Stay here.
By Arbenos' scabbard, isn't it my friend and comrade. Welcome to the guildhouse.
Hello sergeant. What are you doing here in Freetown?
Thanks, let's have a drink another time, I am busy now.

"You probably know by now that the 9th Legion has gone rogue and thousands of deserters are now pillaging and worse. The guildmaster is discussing a big contract with the King, so we take care of securing the roads; there might be a lot of work to be done real soon."
Do you know why such a thing happened?
Good to see you're in good shape. Let's have a drink another time.
Can I become a member of the Warrior's Guild?

Rumors say their commander was about to be arrested for treason, together with many of his officers. After so many years of hard fighting deep into the Elder Forest, the men sided with their commander.
I'm sure you can, unless you joined another guild first. But our brothers at New Garand do the recruiting, so you'll need to go there.

I'm recovering from a mission in Nilomar's Cape. I've fought there often, yet I had never before seen that cave. Looks like the bears have been busy digging around. Now we're all here waiting up, the calm before the storm.
What storm?

My beloved Zenmo! Here, have this gold. [BLUE](the woman smiles with joy only briefly, then quickly scowls at her husband and grabs him by the ear)[] What did I tell you about dealing with those individuals? My mother was right, you can't be left to yourself...
Any news about Zenmo, my husband? Please keep searching.
No... Please no... I knew we should have never dealt with criminals. I am grateful to you for at least letting me know, please accept this reward for your efforts, and let me alone with my tears.
Please let me alone with my tears.
Thank you my friend. We learned our lesson and we will stay clear of trouble from now on.
[BLUE](This woman looks at you appraisingly)[] Greetings, you seem to have arrived town recently. Maybe you have come from the south, and met a wine trader called Zenmo on the road?
I have no time to talk, sorry.
No, sorry, I haven't met him. What's the problem?
"Zenmo is my husband. He parted to deliver a wine cargo to a nearby customer, but he has been missing for over two weeks now; I fear the worst. "
I thought here in Mercia the Legion took such matters very seriously, have you reported the case to them?

"Well... No, I haven't. Actually, my husband made a very poor choice, and decided to sell wine to the bandit clan to the south, in the Zamohr Mountains; the Legion must not know, or they'd hang both of us for it. We did it because we needed the money; now I regret our decision, of course."
If you deal with robbers and murderers, they will eventually rob and kill you. It's how it works. If I find him, I'll try to bring him back.
Thank you, adventurer. We're not rich, but I'll reward you if you can bring my husband back home.
Uh... Please take me back to the cell!
I certainly didn't expect to see you again, much less here.
You again? Just leave me alone and don't interfere with my business.
Ah, my dear partner. Do you have three fangs of each?
You, here? In Friguld you told me you were a healer. What are you doing in the hideout of the Seventh House?

And what is an 'adventurer' doing here? We're all businessmen. I didn't lie, I am a healer and my draughts heal the pains of life for many. They bring a peaceful sleepiness that many see as a blessing to escape their hard lives momentarily. Surely if you frequent places like this you are not one to preach to me, are you?
I guess I won't but I don't like you. Goodbye.
Preach? I was wondering if you need more fangs. This business sounds very lucrative.
[BLUE](She smiles and winks an eye)[] Always. Every time you bring me three [BLUE]Giant mamba fang[] and three [BLUE]Coral Snake Fang[], I'll pay you 1300 gold.
No, sorry.
Yes, take them.
Always a pleasure to do business with you.

This tome seems to be one of the few frequently used in the Library. Rather than dealing in true knowledge or lost arts, it narrates silly rumors, romances and antagonisms about famous heroes or wizards from 80 years ago. The tome seems to be pretty useless, except maybe in a waiting room.
I'm not interested in this. It can absorb my soul and lower my traits.
Oh a tabloid. Let's learn all kind of useless facts about people I'll never meet.

Against all expectations, there is an interesting mention: 'But of course the Arch-mage Tremadan didn't attend the party, probably to avoid being seen with her. Such rudeness was never forgiven by the countess, which sent an angry letter to his tower in the Jabal Hills'
Now I know where is the tower located! Good to know.
Curious, but I already knew where the tower is.
Fascinating... I guess?
The title of this ancient tome is 'The Icy Gate'. It is enormous, too big to take it with you. It seems to be written in Imperial, but the words make little sense to you.
Stay away from this thing.
Try to read it aloud.
Suddenly, air is sucked out of your lungs, and you feel yourself falling through a confusing blizzard. Finally you look around, and everything has changed.
Suddenly, air is sucked out of your lungs, and you feel yourself falling through a confusing blizzard. Finally you look around, and everything has changed.
What the...
Greetings again. Anything I can help you with?
In the name of the Golden Hand, welcome to the Grey Library. Please state your reason to visit this place.
I want to access the Library.
I might have some of the ancient necromany tomes your Library is seeking.
Why am I being questioned by a traders' guild when I enter a library?
I am looking for a young man called Sulidar, I was told he might be here.
I have no time for this. Step aside or else...
I must go now.
I must go now.
So that's what you want. Yet our records show that you have harmed our interests in the past, so you'll have to do that elsewhere. Leave now, and don't return.
Very well, our records show that you've helped the Golden Hand. To your right lies the library, which you can access freely. The hall to your left is restricted.
Ah, the pursuit of knowledge, such a lofty goal. Yet, you are a stranger, unknown to us. I am afraid I can't grant you access.

The Library was an abandoned ruin 20 years ago. King Danar the Second, in his wisdom, gave it to us to serve as our guildhouse in the upper floors. In exchange we take care of the library in the ground floor.
This is not the place to inquire about lost kids whereabouts. If that's what brings you here, I suggest you leave.
Is that so? Show me what you have brought. I will offer you a thousand gold coins per tome.
Take this one: 'Tolassian Embalming Codex'. It says mummies have trouble making friends... Too wrapped up in themselves.
Take this one: 'On Imperial Necromancy'. It talks about grave matters, no doubt.
Take this one: 'Of Ghosts and Spectres'. A lovely story, you can see through the characters.
Take this one: 'Vampire: the Myth'. But I warn you, the main character sucks.
Nothing yet, but I keep looking.
You did the right thing by bringing them to me instead of those buffoons in New Garand. Here is your reward. What else brings you here?
Then, what else brings you here?
I'll leave... For now.
I won't leave. If you think you can stop me, you're free to try.
What can I do to improve my standing with your guild, and be allowed in here?
[BLUE](Smiles coldly)[] As you wish. I had hoped that you'd say something like that.

"As a matter of fact... we're very interested in acquiring the four unique tomes dealing with necromancy, lost nowadays; if you ever run into them, come to me. But beware, for those shallow-minded 'loreseekers' in New Garand seem to be after them as well."

"As a matter of fact... we're very interested in acquiring the four unique tomes dealing with necromancy, lost nowadays; But beware, for those shallow-minded 'loreseekers' in New Garand seem to be after them as well. Don't dare to hand them the tomes!"
I can't think of anything. Please don't waste my time any longer.
I can't think of anything. Please don't waste my time any longer.
Very well, if I find them I'll be back.
That was satisfying, wasn't it? [BLUE](The man laughs as searches the corpse and hands you the red Key from Rolf)[] A pleasure to do business with you.
Do you bring the promised gems?
You can tell that scoundrel we're even. But if I was you, I'd choose my friends more carefully.
[BLUE](The hooded man examines you carefully, then seems to relax)[] Get lost.
Go away, leave us alone.
I'm here to talk to you. Rolf Erhar told me you want to kill him.
Time to die, scum.
Alright, no need to get nervous.
You dare to mention that scoundrel's name here? The bastard kept all the gems for himself, and he'll pay for that treachery with his life.
He claims he threw the gems to the river, you don't believe him?

[BLUE](He smirks)[] In our line of business, no one believes a word said by anyone else. Even if he says the truth, he should have stayed cool: the guards never got him, so it was for nothing. Go tell your friend he's a dead man.
I'll bring the gems to you. Would that make you change your mind and spare Rolf?
I'm tired of your ranting. Your life ends now.
Actually... He's not my friend. He betrayed me, and almost got me killed. Maybe I could bring him to you.
[BLUE](He smiles cruelly)[] If you do that, you can keep whatever you find in his corpse except the gems, in the remote case he still keeps them. Deal?
Deal, I'll bring him to you.
On second thought, that'd be terrible. I'd rather not.
You are going to pay for wasting my time!
You insult us. We've been weeks after that bastard, and now you want us to walk home just with the loot we deserved in the first place? No, we want revenge.
Do it, or I'll force you to.
You forget you will get to keep Rolf's part if you accept that.
You have two choices here, one of them is clear profit, while the other involves a fight with me and no earnings. Remember, a true thief never gambles.
Very well... You have a point. Bring me one ruby, one emerald, one sapphire and three pearls, and I'll consider the matter settled.
I don't know who you are, but very soon you'll realize what a big mistake you made.
Not yet, but soon. I'll be back.
No. I have decided I won't give you anything, but a painful death.
Yes. Here you got. [BLUE](Give him the gems)[]
[BLUE](He nods)[] You are true to your word, unlike that scoundrel you've chosen as friend. Very well, I consider the matter settled.
[BLUE](The shady man seems to be watching the alley, but other than a brief nod, he doesn't seem interested in you)[]
Hello. Anything interesting around here?
Better not approach shady people in alleys, it's what my mother always said.
Oh, you are a Brother of the Seventh House, I've heard of you. If you want to enter the guildhouse, go to that door at the end of the alley and knock twice, wait, and then knock twice again.

Oh, you are the guy that helped Kardagis, I've heard of you. If you want to enter the guildhouse, go to that door at the end of the alley and knock twice, wait, and then knock twice again. But not being a member, enter at your own risk...
Leave me alone, will you. I'm busy.
"Freedom, foreigner. As you have no business here, please get away from the slave pit; there's many sickly slaves, and we don't want it to spread."
And how do you know I have no business here? Maybe I want to buy slaves.
I've always observed slaves are healthy and clean in Mercian towns, what is going on here?

You are rather ignorant if you believe we allow slaves to be purchased for selfish reasons. All slaves are owned by the Kingdom, and assigned by contract to citizens that can put them to work for the Kingdom's profit.

It is indeed a problem, yes, I am very worried about it. Over the last couple years, there has been too much sickness in the city, and slaves are getting the worst. No one has been able to find the cause.
You saved the kid, well done! I'll make sure he is more cautious in the future. Here, have some gold to cover your expenses.
You brought the kid back, well done! I'll make sure he is more cautious in the future. Here, have some gold to cover your expenses.
Dead you say... Well, it's his own fault, and I even sent someone to try to bring him back. Stupid rookies.
Hello again. Mind your step, don't slip on the blood.
Ah, the kid that helped out Kardagis. But you're not a member of the House, so don't think I'll be helping you with training unless you help me first.
Ah, the kid that helped out Kardagis. I wonder if you can help me with a... Situation.
Tell me what needs to be done.
I require training.
Goodbye.

Oh it's simple enough, nothing dangerous. A recruit called Sulidar entered the [BLUE]Grey Library[], probably trying to steal a book or two. However, days have passed and he hasn't returned. He probably left and is now selling the loot in Varsilia, the bastard, but just in case...

You helped me out, so why not... If you can afford the required gold. I can teach you how to accelerate your melee attacks into a [BLUE]Flurry[], or how to prepare proper surprises for your enemies with [BLUE]Explosive Traps[]

Sure, anything for a House member... If you can afford the required gold. I can teach you how to accelerate your melee attacks into a [BLUE]Flurry[], or how to prepare proper surprises for your enemies with [BLUE]Explosive Traps[]
Like I said, I won't trust a stranger so easily. Maybe if you help me first...
Like I said, no until you solve that little problem I have with Sulidar gone missing into the Grey Library.
Very well, tell me what needs to be done.
Unfortunately, I am busy.
The Grey Library?

Yes, a huge building made of grey stone, here in Freetown. The first floor still works as library, but the King gave the upper floors to those blasted merchants, the Golden Hand, as their headquarters.
Why haven't you sent someone else to look for him, or even gone yourself?

The Golden Hand knows of us very well, they'd stop me or my men at the front gate. That's why I sent our youngest House brother, still not on the records. You, being a stranger in town, probably could enter and find out if he's still there.
Tell me more about Flurry.
Tell me more about Explosive Traps.
I will think about all this.
You're just heartless scum, you know.
Whatever, I don't care. Can you train me?
[BLUE](Chuckles)[] Yeah maybe. It's part of the job description.
[BLUE](The rogue goes pale and shivers in terror when he recognizes Nifuruc and the others)[] You... You sold me! No, wait, wait I can explain this, noooo....!
Finally, free! I might reconsider my career, maybe my dad was right and being a fisherman would suit me better.
I can't believe you managed to convince them. You saved my life! Here is your reward, as promised.
Word is everywhere, you got rid of them! Here is your reward, as promised.
Did you find that band of thugs?
Please, take care of Nifuruc's thugs, will you?
Oh, it is you! No hard feelings about that little trick I played on you back in Kingsbridge, right?
Nah, it's fine. So what are you doing here, planning your next move?
You again! Don't dare to try to fool me, I warn you.

I'm stuck here, kid. My last job was a disaster and my comrades believe I gave them the fold, but the truth is I lost the gems. They won't listen, and if I set a foot on the streets, I am a dead man. Truly, it saddens me to see nobody trust another human being anymore.
I can't blame them, considering your record.
What are those gems you lost?
Well, that's tough luck, but you probably deserve it. Goodbye.
I have lied often, as part of my job. But never to a companion or House brother. I'd never be stupid enough to do that!

It was the Ruchard Baroness' gem collection! Emeralds, rubies, pearls... Magnificent! But the guard was about to fall on me, so I panicked and threw the bag to the river. If the Legion had found it on me, they'd have quartered me on the spot.
Wait! Please you have to help me. I am out of gold, hungry and sick of this place. I need to get out.
Why would I help a man that tricked me in the past?
Because of this [BLUE](Shows you an ancient red key)[]. It is my last posession, a key to one of the Royal Crypts, out there in the Iron Valley. Solve my problem and it will be yours!
Hmmm... I don't know if I can trust you.
You can, you can! Those damn thugs out there are led by a cuttroath called Nifuruc. Please get rid of them, and the key is yours.
Yes, I scared them away and they won't bother you. Let's go to the Valiant King tavern to celebrate.
Excellent! I accept your generous invitation. Lead the way, friend.
Let's go.
This door is locked.
This door is locked.
Knock on it as I was instructed.
Freedom, foreigner. As many city visitors, I am sure you want to see the Games in the Arena, but unfortunately it is closed due to... Technical difficulties.
Ah, it is the champion. Apparently nobody is bold enough to challenge you as of today, but who knows what will happen tomorrow.

Freedom, foreigner. I  offer you the opportunity of a lifetime: become a gladiator in the Arena. You'll earn money and fame, and more importantly, raise the spirits of the common folk of our fine Kingdom. I need one more gladiator to start the season. What do you say?
I am glad to see you, gladiator. Are you ready for a fight?
Already here? We're still cleaning up all the blood and gore from your last show. Try again tomorrow.
Not my thing, really, but thanks for asking.
Murdering people for the amusement of the crowd? Disgusting.
I am intrigued. Tell me more.

Foreigners always believe their own reasons for killing are the only acceptable ones. [BLUE](Rolls his eyes)[]. But suit yourself, I guess I'll just call the Slavemaster to bring me one of those rebel captives instead.
You'll force someone to enter the Arena? To avoid that I might be willing to take his position. Tell me more.

"Good, good. Foreigners are loved by the crowd, variety is excellent for business. There's really not much to explain; you walk in alone without any of your fancy items; we'll provide a variety of basic gear. Of course all fights are to the death, but I'm sure you already knew that. If you survive, you'll earn a nice gold reward."
Without my gear? Forget it.
Sounds good. Count me in.
May you die a glorious death in the Arena, and may you enjoy great fame and fortune until that day comes. When you are ready for your first fight come and talk to me.
Who is my opponent at the Arena?

"I'll take you to the preparation area. But first, remember you must enter alone, and you will leave all your possessions in a chest; you'll recover them when you survive the fight. If you survive, that is."
Understood.  [BLUE](Walk into the Great Arena)[]
On second thought, I'll be back later.
Understood. But before going in, I was wondering if maybe you could do something to improve my odds. You know, to make a better show. A potion or two would be enough.
[BLUE](Looks uneasily left and right)[] I have no idea what you're talking about... And even if I did, what would be in it for me?
Nevermind. I'll be back later.
If you know I am going to win, you can make a lot of money placing the right bets.
Name your price.
Very well... for [BLUE]3000 gold[] I'll add some little extra to your chest before all your fights begin. It is a lot of money, but you'll earn more by just winning a couple times. Deal?
Very well, here is the money. [BLUE](Pay 3000 gold)[]
Nevermind. I'll be back later.
Indeed... But I still need some money to bet. For [BLUE]1500 gold[] I'll add some little extra to your chest before all your fights begin.
Very well, here is the money. [BLUE](Pay 1500 gold)[]
Nevermind. I'll be back later.
[BLUE](He offers you a wry smile and a nod before walking in through a door)[] This way, please.

"Your first fight will not be happening at the Arena; we need to know if you're a good show first. We arranged what we call a 'Dog Fight' for you in a cage, against a beast. We'll see how well you do in a narrow space. "
We have another Dog Fight ready for you. It's not so easy to debut in the Great Arena, you know. Provide some more fun to the crowd and we'll see.
It'll be another Dog Fight... But beware, not against a beast. You'll fight another gladiator for the right to enter the Great Arena.
You are ready for the Great Arena. Your first opponent will be a Deserter Decurion. If she wins she'll become a free woman, so you can imagine she won't hesitate to split your head open.
"I hope you're ready for a challenge. Some minotaurs were captured near Jabal; they're bloodthirsty and strong beasts, I am sure it'll be quite a show."
You are raising quickly in rank, some in the crowd already cheer your name. But your next fight against a band of mercenaries could be your last.
After you get killed by your next opponent I'm going to miss our nice chats. He's a Hill Giant, and after crushing you he'll be allowed to eat you. No wonder he's the favorite of the crowd.
You're going to face a unique challenge... The only one that survived it before is the current Arena champion. I can't tell you more, unfortunately, except that you'll most certainly die.

"The arena champion awaits you now. He was once an elite legion scout but went missing; months ago he returned to Freetown and became a murderer, terrorizing the population. Finally he was arrested and sentenced to death in the Arena, but he has managed to kill every opponent and monster thrown at him, becoming the Champion. "
So the champion is a serial killer, at least I guess the crowd will back me this time.

"I doubt they will. The same people that feared him now cheer him as a hero! Such is the greatness of the Arena; the champion is just one fight away from regaining his freedom. I suggest you pray to your gods, foreigner, for Sargos the Madman spares no one."
Sargos??? Decurion Sargos... It's been a while since we met.
Ohhh so you two have a past feud! Wonderful for business! I'll make sure everybody knows before the fight. Are you ready?
I am ready!
I still need to prepare. I'll be back.
Are you ready for battle?
Yes, let's go!
I need a little more time here.
Actually I changed my mind. I want to leave.
The only way out of here is surviving your fight.
[BLUE](You are taken to a large cage surrounded by a noisy crowd. A fierce bear is released in front of you)[]
[BLUE](You are taken to a large cage surrounded by a noisy crowd. Two raging sabercats jump on you)[]
[BLUE](You are taken to a large cage surrounded by a noisy crowd. A man clad in leather armor and carrying a longsword smiles, approaching you)[]
[BLUE](You enter the Great Arena, overwhelmed by the thousands cheering and shouting. But you don't have much time for that, as an armored woman charges at you!)[]
"[BLUE](You enter the Great Arena once more. Around you there are several huge minotaurs; they seem confused and angry, and some of them charge at you)[]"
"[BLUE](You enter the Great Arena once more. Several armored rogues surround you as they bare their weapons; they look at each other, smiling with confidence)[]"
"[BLUE](This time you need to make no effort to identify your foe. A huge Hill Giant runs towards you; the earth trembles at each of his steps)[]"
[BLUE](Even before you enter the Arena you notice the smell... Trolls! How are you supposed to deal with them???)[]
[BLUE](The towering figure of Sargos stands in the middle of the Arena. He has painted a spider on his face, using blood. He smiles at you)[]
Welcome home, veteran.
Freedom, adventurer. Access to the Warriors' Guild is restricted to our members and close allies.
How could I help the guild and become an ally?
I fought side to side with Sergeant Dummek in Kingsbridge. Together we conquered the orc fort.
Tell me more about the Warriors' Guild.
I don't really want to enter. Probably nothing of interest inside.
Maybe find some of the officiers out there working on a contract, and help them out. I heard Sergeant Dummek in Kingsbridge is having a hard time.
Indeed a tale of courage that we all have heard about. Welcome.

"We're all brothers and sisters in arms. Some say we're mere mercenaries, but we will only take a honorable contract. We don't take sides in Kingoms' politics, and we don't accept contracts that go against unarmed populations. Most of us are not noble; but some Varsilian second sons tired of the power struggle, have chosen to join us."
That sounds interesting. Can I go in?
Like I said, entry is restricted to our members and close allies.
I don't know what you did, but it worked! The ghost has not been sighted again, and you have my gratitude. Here is the money.

So the ghost told you his name? Sir Morfados? I know that name, I've read his works about military tactics. He was one of the rebels that confronted the empire a century ago, before the Kingdoms existed. I think he died in the Battle of Deadwood, when the Empire crushed the rebellion.
You found Sir Morfados' remains? Well, let me tell you that didn't do any good. The spectre is still haunting the hills every night. You better think of something to placate his anger.

"When you fight, never take a step back. Your foe's destruction must be your only thought; may your rage bring despair to the heart of your enemies! Let their fear be your mightiest ally, as you become a merciless minister of death."
That sounds fantastic, but how do I achieve that? Can you train me?
I was wondering if there's any work to do for the guild.
Not really my style. Also, let's be friends, okay?
Sorry but usually I only train members of the Warrior's Guild.
I can train you to become a monster in the battlefield with [BLUE]Battle Rage[], or [BLUE]Bloodlust[].
Tell me more about Battle Rage.
Tell me more about Bloodlust.
I will think about all this.
Can you make an exception?
Understood.
Maybe, if you finish the job I assigned you. Go and eliminate that spectral knight.
I have my hands full, you see. I've been ordered to close all pending tasks as soon as possible, yet there's a matter I might need to solve personally. I have no time to train non-members, sorry.
Maybe I could help you with that unfinished task.

"You are a godsend. There has been some trouble with a certain ghostly knight appearing at South Jabal Hills during nights. He's very agressive, and our guild was asked to deal with it; I sent a few veterans, all of them experienced in fighting the undead... but they barely escaped alive."
Not at the moment. We're all on hold while the guild heads negotiate with the king.
You mean besides the job I already gave you? Go and eliminate that spectral knight.
Well, if your veterans couldn't hand it, I might need to wait before I can face such a challenge.
I'm interested, count on me.
A wise decision. Live another day to train and get stronger.
Very well, the job is yours. The reward will be two thousand gold coins, providing you eliminate that wandering spirit permanently.
This fleshy mass agitates and trembles, as living things appear to crawl inside. It looks extremely thick and resilient.
Smash it with your weapon
Stay away from this thing
Pour [BLUE]spider venom[] through some opening.
Pour [BLUE]scorpion venom[] through some opening.
[BLUE](You notice an opening on top, some kind of breathing hole. You could pour down poison, but unfortunately don't have any)[]

Welcome to our camp, traveller. Life here is hard, but we manage to survive the goblins. Those giant ants, on the other hand, are a problem... We're considering leaving the place, after so much work.
Hello again. Not so easy to kill the buggers, right?
A mirmek nest? In the outside? That is very strange... Maybe you could tell our ranger  about that. His name is Nisor.  Anyways, you did it, here is your reward.
Hello there, bug-hunter. You may want to talk to our ranger, Nisor, about that mirmek nest you found.
Hello there, bug-hunter.
Why would one want to live in a place like this, full with monsters and away from everywhere?
Giant ants!!?? Gross. Didn't your mother teach you how to keep your kitchen clean?
That sounds fun, how big is a giant ant anyways, the size of a rat? Or a cat?

You'll understand easily enough: gold and rubies. In this river, if you're patient, you can find gold pebbles. And in the cave to the north, some rubies. If you're brave enough to face the giant ants living there, that is.
Very funny, looks like we have a travelling comedian visiting us. I'd really laugh at one giant ant eating you whole, now that'd make a nice joke.
They're Mirmeks. Some larger than a wolf, and some are larger than a horse. They're fierce, armored like a knight, and their maws are sharp as steel. But go see them for yourself, up to the north.
That sounds dangerous. Are the Mirmeks attacking you?
Wait, they're that big?!?! Okay, I think I am going to leave this place now. Goodbye!
Yes, until now they stayed in their caves, but now they're coming out every day and getting closer. We try to hunt them, but there's always more of them. We're very worried about this.
You know, I am a specialist at killing things. Maybe we could make a deal.
You're just not killing them right. You might need the help from an expert...
Poor insects, you're heartless!
Well, we have money, and we can use the help. Make sure the mirmek stay in their caves and I'll pay you 200 gold.
Yeah, poor little things. I suggest you cross the bridge and go give them a big hug.
This ancient book is ruined and about to poof into a cloud of dust, but you can at least look at the page currently open, and thanks to its magic, you understand the alien symbols on it.
Read the passage.
Go away from this book.

It says: The [BLUE]Crown of Tol[], and the [BLUE]Eye of Tol[] are sacred artifacts forged millenia ago in another world, by our Lord Tol himself. Just as He was Mangled, the Eye was shattered in endless pieces, and the Crown was sundered. The High Priest keeps the crown until the day the Lord returns to reclaim it.
Ah I had already learned about this. Sounds ominous.
A Mangled God which will return... Sounds ominous.
[BLUE](Once more, you listen to a woman's voice echoing inside your head as the insect faces you)[] Well? What about that ungrateful daughter of mine, Zuz'sare?

[BLUE](This enormous creature emanates a formidable aura of power. Suddenly, you hear a woman's voice inside your head)[] Here you are. The Unaware One. Through the eyes of my daughters I saw you approaching, so I crawled up from the depths to meet you.
You have come to me too soon. When you need to find the broken shards of destiny, when you realize the shadow is growing above us all, come to me.
[BLUE](This enormous creature emanates a formidable aura of power. Suddenly, you hear a woman's voice inside your head)[] Welcome again, Unaware One.
What's this? Get out of my head, now.
I don't talk with monsters, I just kill them.
What am I 'unaware' of? Who are you?

[BLUE](She produces a strange hissing and burbling, which probably means she is laughing)[] I am not inside your head. I can read most minds, but not yours. It is you the one knowing my toughts, actually.
I don't believe you, monster. Time to die.
Very well... Then tell me What am I 'unaware' of, and who are you.

I am afraid, it wouldn't be in my best interest to answer the first question. As for the second, it is not easy to answer, but I guess a name is a good start. You can refer to me as Undermother. I rule the mirmek, all of them are my daughters.
I don't trust you. Goodbye.
Let me guess, I have killed a lot of your daughters, so you are now mad at me.
Would you mind telling your daughters to stop attacking me?
"No, of course not. I have over seven million daughters. I advise them not to come close to the surface; if they do so, it's their choice. Their deaths will make my other daughters wiser."
Why would I interfere in their hunting? The stronger one must prevail, that is the way.
I see. Well, from your words, it's obvious you wanted to talk to me. Tell me what do you want from me.
You have come to me too soon. When you need to find the broken shards of destiny, when you realize the shadow is growing above us all, come to me.

I advise you to think carefully if that is a wise choice. When your Empire was still young,  I was laying my eggs on the corpses of dragons. I'd rather not destroy you if I can avoid it, but if you leave me no choice...
Enough talk. Die.
When you put it that way, attacking you really sounds like a terrible idea. Let's just talk.
I am glad to see you acting with wisdom, Unaware One. You may be in need of that wisdom very soon.
What am I 'unaware' of? Who are you?
Very well, goodbye.
Answer me something at least. Your daughters have been nesting outside, near a human settlement. Why did you order them to do so?
I didn't. They were seduced away by some strange person wearing a grey robe. I didn't like it much, but it was their mistake to go to the surface in the first place.
You mentioned something about shards... Now I happen to be looking for certain magical glass shards. What do you know? It is vital for me to locate them.
Goodbye.

[BLUE](She produces a strange hissing and burbling, which probably means she is laughing)[] You are seeking the shards of the Eye. Don't pretend ignorance with me, for I am the only creature still alive that has gazed at it. I also know why you try to find it: a noble cause, so I wish to aid you.
Help me? First tell me in exchange of what. I don't want to be fooled.

In exchange of nothing. I will tell you the location of one of the shards. Months ago, my daughter Zuz'sare found and devoured it, lured by its power. She became mad with the magical influence, and very strong. She tried to devour me, even. I defeated her, but she escaped, through the surface.
Any idea of where she can be?

I have not ventured out into the surface in centuries, and I have no intention to do it now. Go recover your shard, and punish the prodigal daughter. If you bring me her head, I will reward you with something else as well: knowledge.
I'm still working on it. Goodbye.
I can't find her. Where do you think she might be?
Oh, about that... It's funny that you ask... [BLUE](Prepare the Charm from Zuz'sare)[]
Zuz'sare is dead. Someone else had killed her when I arrived.
I killed her. And you were right, I retireved a Shard off her corpse.
That can't be. Had she truly been destroyed, I would have sensed it. She's still alive, and whoever fed you that information was lying to you.

Of course I was right.  Much is, what the Undermother knows and everyone else ignores. You obtained your Shard and I had my revenge, now it's time for me to return to the entrails of the earth. You know, in case you fail in your quest.
You mentioned you'd share some important knowledge if I killed Zuz'sare.
"You will die here and now. Zuz'sare told me there's another Shard inside of you; you made a mistake sending me out to meet her."

Indeed, there is much I could teach you, Unaware One. Wherever there is a small ant on a wall, the Undermother has eyes and ears. But there is so little time... I'll just share with you the most important bit.
Do you happen to know where the Forsaken are hidden, and where they keep a girl called Amarisa?

"No, they're well hidden; but I know you're being fooled. You've been told the Forsaken need Tremadan's blood, or that of his descendants, and in part it's true. But why? Do Archmages have a special kind of blood, useful as reagent? No. It was a lie."
It sounded a bit weird to me but... I don't get it. ¿Why did he lie about that?
I won't say more. There might be a future time when you have to make an important choice, and then such knowledge might prove useful to you. Farewell. [BLUE](Sinks underground in an instant)[]
I am sure a gigantic Mirmek overflowing with magical energy won't go unnoticed by you surfacers. Listen to some rumors about unusual things, and you might find her.
Ah, your death here and now does not suit my plans in the long term. But I admit it will be satisfying to consume your flesh.
[BLUE](The Charm projects a bolt of green energy that impacts the Undermother. She hisses in pain first, then in anger)[] My magical barriers, gone! Impossible! You'll pay for this, pathetic traitor.
We'll see who pays...
Even being weakened, you are no match for me.... But wait... What is this presence I am feeling? This is priceless... Zuz'sare here... An alliance of weaklings will be crushed today.
Even being weakened, you are no match for me. Die now!
"An obviously magical door covered in runes, with no keyhole or handles; all it shows is a picture, resembling a fearsome Earth Elemental."
Put your hand on the door and hope for the best.
No way I am going to touch this thing.

You feel a pleasant humming... And then it smells like tasty food. Wait, no! The smell comes from a powerful electrical shock, burning through your flesh.
Walk inside.
Maybe another time.

Keep reading.

I better go.

Pour scorpion venom over it and say 'Trelaxx'!
Pour some of your water over it and say 'Trelaxx'!

The magical gate opens and you advance through a dark corridor. When you finally reach a brightly lit chamber, you notice you were expected.

The magical gate opens and you advance through a dark corridor. When you finally reach a brightly lit chamber, you notice you were expected. And unfortunately, you find yourself trapped inside an iron cage while toxic gas hisses around you.

[BLUE](You walk a dark corridor until a loud clanking makes you jump. You are trapped in a metallic cage! To make things worse, a green cloud of poison raises, suffocating you. At the other side of the iron bars you see archers pointing at you. A familiar voice greets you)[] Welcome, bounty hunter.

[BLUE](You walk a dark corridor until a loud clanking makes you jump. You are trapped in a metallic cage! At the other side of the iron bars you see archers pointing at you. A familiar voice greets you)[] Welcome, bounty hunter.
Zilda? The girl from the harbor? What are you doing here?
You still don't get it...[BLUE](Smiles)[] Call me Snake!

We can talk just fine as we are now. You said you need the Shard located inside the Golden Cove Bank. And I've heard of your reputation in the north. I might be willing to help you, as I've been planning that robbery myself for a long time.
We can talk just fine as we are now. While you look different from those bounty hunters, I can't afford to trust you my dear. Now speak, what do you want?
Stupid bandit! All I want is the reward, and cage or not I will kill you.
