My reasons are my own.
You are no bandit, you are a rebel fighting a tyrant. I want to help your cause.
Sorry but that won't do, I want to know the motives of those working with me. Refuse to speak and you'll be left to die where you are.
Enough nonsense. You want to rob that bank as much as I do, and you need me for it. You know it's true.
It's the money, of course. What else? Let me out!
Disappointing... if you work for money you could turn on me at the first chance. I don't want to kill you, but unfortunately I can't set you free now that you know so much.

[BLUE](Amused)[] Is that so? I seem to remember your words in the docks said otherwise... [BLUE](The poisonous cloud makes your lungs burn)[]. And don't blame me for that gas, you activated the trap yourself with that scorpion venom.
What did you expect me to say? I was just trying to get the information from you. What I truly want is robbing the Golden Cove Bank.
Stupid bandit! All I want is the reward, and cage or not I will kill you.

"Very well. For some unfathomable reason I trust you. I won't lie to you, I've planned such robbery for a very long time. But I lacked the means for it; my men are not experienced enough to survive. Maybe with your help..."
Why is it important to you too?
Tell me more about the Golden Cove Bank.
Will I become an Outlaw in the Kingdoms for doing this?
Agreed then, let's do it. What's the plan?
After careful consideration I've decided it's probably easier to simply kill you and try my luck talking to the Governor. Prepare to die.
That bank not only holds gold, adventurer. There's some important documents there that may give me the Governor's head served on a silver plate.

"Here in Friguld the guards will hate you, but not other people. And it might slightly affect your reputation in Mercia and Varsilia, not further north.  Unless we kill some innocent, that is; in that case, the tale will spread."

The most vile place in all the Southern Lands. It keeps the fortunes of corsairs, crime lords, and of course Varsilian nobles avoiding taxes. The Wizard's Guild helped to build it, so we can expect magical defenses, but unfortunately I don't know much more.
Can we try to sneak in?
That is usually my tactic, but I am afraid there is only one way in: the main entrance. A magical barrier blocks the access to the vaults, but I'm sure we can find a way to pass through it.
Meet me at the bank desk when you're ready. Until then, stay out of trouble!
[BLUE](Ignoring you, she makes a gesture to the archers before leaving)[] Stay here until it's done, I'll be in my chamber.
The grate is already broken open.
This sturdy grate is covered in sharp iron spikes. Maybe you could try to slam it open, but it doesn't look easy and you'll probably get hurt.
Slam against it!
There's a small crack between two bars... Insert your weapon and try to pry it open.
Use all your might to charge against it furiously.
You manage to break it open!
Despite your efforts and pain, the iron grate still stands.
We've already talked, haven't we? Now I have business to attend.
[BLUE](This alluring Friguldian woman smiles mockingly)[] Lost your way, sailor?
Sorry I must be on my way.
Are you Zilda? I'd like to talk about the Snake Gang.
[BLUE](She pales)[] I already told the Governor's men all I knew. All I got from this is trouble! I have no idea where to find them! Please leave me alone.
I think the men who interrogated you were not persuassive enough. Tell me what you know or you'll die here and now. [BLUE](Grab her wrist)[]
Easy, I'm not working for that pig you call Governor. I need their skills to recover an artifact to save the world.
I'm no threat to you, actually here's [BLUE]250 gold[] to prove my good will.
I'll just leave then.
No please, don't hurt me! I'll tell you what you want to know.
That's a good girl. I'm listening. [BLUE](Release her)[]
¡A world savior knocking at my door! [BLUE](She laughs charmingly)[] Are you a lunatic? Or a charlatan?
Damn wench, I'll teach you to mock me! [BLUE](Grab her wrist)[]
I need that black shard which is locked inside the bank. There is a big danger for everyone unless I get it fast. If I was a liar I'd make up a simpler story, really.
Forget I mentioned saving the world. I am willing to compensate you for your time, here's [BLUE]250 gold[] to prove my good will.

[BLUE](She looks at you apparaisingly)[] Call me an idiot, but I believe you're not like the rest of pirates and cutthroats living in this hellhole. I'll tell you what I know and damned be common sense.
Thank you! So, where can I find The Snake?

There's a stone door in a cave in Emerald Valley. It is magical, you need to recite the password 'Trelaxx' while pouring some water over it. That's where the gang hides. Now if you excuse me, I must go to sleep.
There's a stone door in a cave in Emerald Valley. It is magical, you need to recite the password 'Trelaxx' while pouring [BLUE]scorpion venom[] over it. That's where the gang hides.
Where can I find that venom?
Your cooperation is appreciated.
It's sold around here, or you can get it off Manticores if you're brave enough. Now I need to go.

[BLUE](The coins quickly disappear through hidden pockets in her bodice)[] Now you're talking, friend. But I need to know what would you do if you found The Snake. [BLUE](Winks)[]. I've heard the reward for his head is remarkable, and I'd love to see some of it!
I intend to come back and spend the reward with you, we'll have a hell of a party, I tell you.
Actually, I just need to discuss business with The Snake. I doubt I'll get that reward, sorry.
Oh I can't wait! I'll tell you what you want, but please come back soon.
You can bet I will. ¿Where do I find The Snake?
Are you sure? I'd really love to hang out with the one that got rid of The Snake... So exciting... I would love to see all that money together. [BLUE](She pouts deliciously)[]
Like I said, I'm not into this for the bounty, nor I intend to have business with the Governor. Now, will you tell me what you know?
When you put it that way, it is really hard to say no. Very well, I'll get rid of that Snake and come back to show you the reward.
Aww bummer! [BLUE](She smiles mischievously)[] I guess the gold you paid is enough for the information you seek.
[BLUE](You casually put a hand on the stone face and you feel a sudden chill. A voice speaks in your head)[] Finally... You have brought my Crown and I wake up from my long slumber...
The stone face remains inert.
This doesn't sound good, does it...?
Descend to me! [BLUE](You feel yourself being pulled down, and soon everything around you is blackness)[]

[BLUE](This young woman is barely an adult, yet in her eyes you see an otherworldy wisdom, and her stance makes clear she's a veteran commander. You think at first you've seen her face before, but you can't put your finger on when or where.)[] You are safe under our watch, traveller.

[BLUE](She smiles and looks at you in the eyes)[] Yes, my dreams had told me that you would be the one to come in our hour of need. I never doubted. [BLUE](She puts on the medallion, which gleams as she recites some words, and suddenly you feel a strange peace. Men raise their arms and praise the Three, chanting)[]. Please accept this gift, as token of friendship.
We'll resist as long as it's possible, but I fear the endurance of my brothers is reaching its limit. Please try to recover Sir Tamrel's holy symbol.

My friend, thanks to your aid, this place will endure, and eventually we might build a chapel that rises above the dunes. As soon as my duty here ends, I will return to New Garand. I hope we can meet there, as my dreams have told me our fates are now interwined.
Thanks. I won't bother you, I see you're busy.
Thank you, in the name of Their Mercy. Your presence here is an unexpected blessing. May I please talk a moment to you, and learn more about what are you doing here?
Less talking and welcoming, and more going out there to kill more undead... Just saying.
Of course, friend. What you witness here is the last remnant of what was once a heroic attempt at restoring peace in this place. But our failure is now at hand, I am afraid we might retreat soon.

Behind your rudeness, there is truth, and that is what hurts me the most. We came here to be the hunters, but the dead are about to force our retreat. Shameful, you are right, but we're not strong enough to take the fight to them.
I see, so what went wrong here?

Everything. The first expedition led by Sir Tamrel was supposed to be here, expecting us, and with a Consecrated ground, capable of repeling the undead, so we'd have a safe encampment from which to plan our attacks on the undead ruins.
Oh, and they weren't here, then?

"Some of them... Or rather, their zombified bodies [BLUE](She grimaces)[]. An undead army was awaiting us, and ambushed us. We prevailed, but now only a handful of us remain, some of them sickly; and as we have not Consecrated the camp yet, we are attacked all the time. No matter how many we kill, more undead return the next day."
And why don't you do this 'consecration'? Then you'd be safe. Can't you do it?

It requires a great power, which the High Priests in Nivarian contained into Sir Tamrel's Holy Symbol. With that medallion, I would certainly be able to perform the ritual. But I can't go and try to retrieve it. Without me, many of the men here would despair if another attack comes. I must remain here, with my brothers and sisters... until it is time for me to give the shameful order of retreat.
Maybe I could retrieve it for you.
Great tale. And a sad one too. But I don't think I am strong enough to prevail where so many have fallen. Maybe in the future.

I wouldn't ask anyone to risk their lives while I remain behind, so I thank you for your generous offer. Please bring back that medallion. The Three will guard you from the dark perils, I have no doubts.

Your humbleness honors you. And my senses don't fool me, there's more in you than you even know. If you happen to find the sacred medallion in your travels through the Inori, please bring it back. You'd be providing a great service to the Three.
You all came here to the middle of the desert to push back the undead, so it was my duty to help you in any way I could. Goodbye.
Okay, I helped, now I am out of here. The Three and all that blather makes me nervous.

Please, wait a moment... [BLUE](She closes her eyes and nods, as if remembering)[] Our Lord Thelume revealed me that an adventurer, one of shrouded ancestry and a fateful future, would be the one to decide upon the fate of humanity. This adventurer would be the one to help us here, in the Inori. Now I found you. [BLUE](Her eyes open wide)[]
You probably tell that to everyone you meet.
Yeah, that'd be me. What about it, did he happen to mention anything helpful?
This is seriously freaking me out. What else do you know?
Nothing that should be mentioned here or now. But I replied to him with an oath, a sacred vow.

[BLUE](She bursts out in laughter, blushing a little.)[] You are a very different person than the priests and knights I usually deal with. No, I never said that before and never will again. But I answered Thelume with a vow to him.
A vow? What vow?
You guys don't have normal conversations, I see. Tell me what did you vow.
I vowed to follow that adventurer, whatever is the road that puts me on, high or low, dark or light. And whatever is that danger threatening the whole humanity, I'll be ready and destroy it.
I definitely can use any help I can get.
That's good but right now I'd prefer not to
Once my work here is done, I will return to New Garand. Seek me out in the Altar to The Three, I will always be ready for you.
I understand. As I vowed, you are in charge, call me as you need. Once my work here is done, I will return to New Garand. Seek me out in the Altar to The Three, I will always be ready for you.
[BLUE](The man bows down)[] Welcome to this encampment. Even in the deep sands of the Inori, the Three watch over you, and guide you to safety.
I require healing
This is the last place where I'd expect to see a shrine
Can I be of service to The Three?
Greetings, I would like to be your guest, I need to rest.
I can heal you, in exchange of a small contribution to our Shrine.
Here is a small donation. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 25 gold coins, be healed for 25hp)[]
I wish to make a large donation then. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 100 gold coins, be healed for 120hp)[]
Not at the moment thanks. I better be on my way.
By the Power of Arbenos, Thelume and Nivaria, be healed of your wounds!

Yet this is the place where we are needed. The Inori is plagued by the restless dead, and old routes to the south have been abandoned. We hope this camp to be a refuge for those trying to cross the burning sands, so things can be as they once were.
How can you survive in a place like this?
I must be on my way.

"It is not easy. We have a well of fresh water, and we have our faith in the Ones Above. However, you are right; we've lost too many men, and likely we will retreat soon. Instead of finding a Consecrated camp, led by our brother Tamrel, we found an undead army awaiting us. Maybe you saw the bones."
This sounds like a large war effort, from your very distant Ilmara in the north... Shouldn't Varsilia take care of this?

"Ah... But they won't. The King is a good lad, and was ready to send in his knights; but the council, led by Baron Storme, opposed to it. In the end, we had to make a move, and decided to come by ourselves."
The Baron Storme? Isn't he the richest noble in Varsilia? And the most powerful after the King.
This is fascinating but I really must be going.
Exactly. And his brother is the High Priest of the Imperial Religion. He hates our Faith, and would never ally with us, nor give us a chance to strengthen our presence in Varsilia.
Thanks. I must be going.
For that, please ask our superior, Sister Hirge.
That blonde girl, you mean? Isn't she a bit... young, to be in charge?

Sister Hirge is still not twenty, true. But she has been fighting the undead since she felt the Call, at age twelve. Just as her visions said, when we excavated a well here, we found water. She is our only hope in this hour of darkness. Our last hope.
Of course. If possible, can you donate [BLUE]250 gold[] to our holy cause? Bringing resources here is very expensive. If you can't, we understand. You can still be our guest.
Sure, it is a good cause, here is the gold.
I have no money, sorry, but I'll still accept your hospitality.
[BLUE](Lie)[] I have no money, sorry, but I'll still accept your hospitality.
I changed my mind, maybe I'll return later.
Sleep sound and safe, as the Three will watch over the Faithful, and no evil shall dare to disturb you.
[BLUE](His voice is like a chorus of a thousand wishpers)[] Centuries have passed, so many dead souls are lost. My Crown is here... But why a living one brings Tol back from the Dead? Who are you?
Where is my crown?
You're supposed to be a God. Figure it out.
I... Um... I'm going to be brutally honest. I have no idea what I'm doing here. I have this thing cursing me, can you help?
Lord Tol, your High Priest and all your undead ones failed you. They chose not to bring you the Crown.
I've come to destroy you, God of Death.
How did they fail me? What did they do?
I don't know. I am here to get rid of this curse!
I don't know exactly why but they feared your anger and decided not to wake you up.
They enslaved and feasted on the living, breaking the balance you taught them. They have become a terrifying nightmare for us, living ones.

I see. They feared me... Only now I understand how naive I was, or should I say insane. How young and unprepared. I believed I could create an Eden, an immortal civilization. Instead I created a hell, and filled it with monsters.
You don't talk like a God at all. Young? Naive? I don't understand.

[BLUE](Smiles in a very human fashion)[] You have earned the right to ask questions to a God, I'd say. I was once a mortal, an adventurer much like yourself. Me and my companions uncovered an ancient secret and were Ascended, much like others had through the ages.
Others? Do you mean the Eleven?
Exactly. And many others which became Gods before, in ages now forgotten. However, like most Ascended Ones, I made a grave mistake. I decided not to let my humanity go.
What does that mean?

I didn't want to become a timeless being, nor I wanted to lose my personality, my identity, my physical body... my flaws. Yet I wanted the Divine Power. We four decided to do the same, becoming half-god, half-men, with disastrous consequences.
Now I understand, a God with human feelings and flaws is indeed a very dangerous thing.

"Human mind is too small of a vessel to contain such power and knowledge. I vaguely feel the distant presence of my old companions... Two of them went insane and tried to destroy themselves, their souls tormented by regrets; immortality is a cruel prision for them. They betrayed me, feared me. I pity them."
What will you do now?

I shall fulfill my destiny, and trascend this mortal shell once and for all. I shall become the God of the Dead, for millions of souls have perished and are without a guide... Can't you feel the imbalance? The dead refusing to rest? So much to be done! It will take me a long time to repair my mistakes.
Wait, I have lots of questions for you, and maybe you can help me! The world is in danger!

I shall meddle with mortal matters no more. [BLUE](Suddenly his body becomes too bright to stare at)[] I abandon this world, my realm is that of the Dead. Mortal, you have my blessings and my gratitude.
[BLUE](You feel yourself being pulled upwards. As you ascend, visions of the past and future expand your mind granting you 1 Skill Point)[]

Indeed a bold one stands in front of me. You are right to wonder why a God may not know all. While the Divine is part of me, I am also man. Indulge my mortal ignorance and tell me why my appointed servants didn't wake me up centuries ago.
Worry not, for I will bring you peace, child. Eternal peace and balance. Accept my ultimate blessing: death. [BLUE](Your soul begins to escape your body)[]
Is that so? I expected more from someone capable of bringing my crown. Now accept my ultimate blessing: death. [BLUE](Your soul begins to escape your body)[]
This ancient Tolassian statue was probably an artistic wonder once upon a time, but now the centuries have erased most of its features.
Adaon, check this statue!
Is that a small lever behind the statue...? [BLUE](Activate it)[]
Damnit... I have no time to examine statues now.
[BLUE](Coughs heavily)[] I see a small lever, over there!
Good job! [BLUE](Activate it)[]
When you activate it, gas stops hissing into the room, and the iron grates slowly withdraw.
Don't worry, that viper in the sewers will receive her payment tonight.
What do we have here. Having a walk in the desert? [BLUE](These rough-looking men seem to be tense, and ready their weapons)[]
Go away, leave us alone.
Yeah. What about you, star-gazing, right?
No. I am your death. You are the smugglers that crossed the Seventh House. You'll now learn what happens when you forget who rules this city.
Um... Sorry, I probably took a wrong turn at that dune. Goodbye.
Indeed. It is a pretty night for that. Now why don't you keep walking, before you step on a rock and hurt yourself? Good night.
Good idea. Goodbye.
I am afraid both my walk and your star-gazing have come to an end. Certain friends of mine are worried about a guy called Rodo. He might have forgotten his duties to the Seventh House.
[BLUE](He carefully gauges you before replying)[] I see. It might have been my bad memory... or maybe I like to keep my own earnings and not give them away.
I am sure it was your memory. No one would simply decide not to pay, and die over a few coins. It is not reasonable.
So you simply decided not to pay. Time to die.

Rodo, Rodo... I understand you. But you are so wrong. The House controls everything. It is true that you will give up on your profits, but then you can stop worrying about the guard, or about clients not paying you. Stop thinking small.
[BLUE](He listens carefully, then finally nods)[] That... Makes a lot of sense. Very well, agreed. I'll send Kardagis a payment right now.
That's a good decision.
That's a good decision. Especially since I will forget about all your previous due payments, from months of smuggling.
Ain't you a smooth one... Very well, Kardagis will have her payment, and you please accept this. Now begone.
Is that a threat?
Yes. Agree to pay or else...
No, I am just talking, I am not here to execute you. I better leave.

It is, but it is also an opportunity. The House controls everything. It is true that you will give up on your profits, but then you can stop worrying about the guard, or about clients not paying you. Stop thinking small.

Wait wait! I surrender. We will pay you. You win! [BLUE](the man offers you to sit besides him, and hands you cup of tea, smiling)[] My men will prepare the payment, let's sit, drink and talk business in the meantime. I might have a good proposal for you.
Too late for talking, Rodo. [BLUE](Attack)[]
Very well, let's hear that proposal. [BLUE](Sit and drink with him)[]
[BLUE](You notice how he dropped a small powder on your cup. Pretend you will drink it, but then throw it in his face and attack)[] Traitor, bastard! Die!
You think I will let you simply go away, after you found us? [BLUE](You feel the sting of a poison dart, burning on your back)[]
[BLUE](As soon as you sip the tea, it burns your insides, and you feel sick. Poison. Immediately, Rodo and his men jump at you)[]
You think it will be so easy, don't you... [BLUE](You feel the sting of a poison dart, burning on your back)[]

"The carvings on this ancient monolith are very unfamiliar; odd shaped curves, forming circular figures of great intrincacy. You see the shilouette of a very large hand in the middle of the monolith."
No way I'm touching this.
Let's see what happens if I touch this...
Nothing happens. If there was magic inside this stone, maybe it died long ago.
As soon as you touch it, you feel as if you were falling through a very long tunnel...
You seem to be at a different place!
[BLUE](As you approach the door, a disembodied voice echoes in your mind)[] You are not welcome by the Wizard's Guild. Leave now, or we'll use force without hesitation.
This door hums with a strange aura, but doesn't appear to be locked.
Enter the tower.
Stay outside.
This door is magically locked.
This door is magically locked, but as soon as you come close it recognizes you as a guild member and opens wide, revealing a staircase.
Go upstairs.
Stay in this floor.
[BLUE](The kind middle-aged sorceress smiles )[] I am Lady Misara, from Icemist. Pleased to meet you.
I want to join the Wizard's Guild. Can you help me?
Do you offer training?
Nevermind, goodbye.

I don't think so, youngster. The Guild raises its own apprentices. We're not a bunch of rogues or mercenaries hungry for young blood, like the other guilds. Still if you believe yourself to be worthy, feel free to visit the College of Magic in Icemist. I highly doubt they'll be interested, be warned.
How can I get to the town of Icemist?

"More than a town, Icemist is a magical fortress. Very few are allowed in. Try to gain as much reputation as possible by helping the guild members in all four Enclaves; with their recommendation, you might be allowed to enter."

I can certainly teach a youngster like you a trick or two. However, I won't train someone that is a complete stranger and hasn't earned the trust of our Guild. [BLUE](You need a reputation of at least 7 with the Wizard's Guild)[]
I can certainly teach a youngster like you a trick or two. However, I charge as much as the Guild does. Interested?
What can you teach me?
Maybe another time, thanks.

I am a specialist in protection magic. By learning [BLUE]Mage Barrier[] your Mage Armor skill will become far more powerful. It can also be wise to learn [BLUE]Shock Ward[] in case one day you meet hostile Sparklings.
Tell me more about Mage Barrier
Tell me more about Shock Ward.
Maybe another time.
Ahhh wonderful indeed. Finally, I can give my research the final push.
Hello again. Where are my chunks of [BLUE]living ice[]? Hurry with that, I need to get out of this sand hell...
Welcome to the Inori Enclave of the Wizard's Guild. You are not a member of our guild, so this hall is the only part of the tower in which you will be allowed.
I need teleportation using your magic circle.
Are there any jobs that I can do for the Wizard's Guild?
Do you have anything for sale?
The Wizard's Guild? Enclave? We're in Varsilia, I thought the wizards were in Thuram. Why the King of Varsilia allows you in here?
Okay, thanks, but I must be going.
Sure, we can teleport you to one of our enclaves through the Kingdoms [BLUE](he points to a map)[]. But as you're not a member, nor an ally to our guild, the fee will be [BLUE]500 gold[].
Fine, teleport me to the Sagar Enclave, near [BLUE]Lannegar[]! Here is my gold.
Fine, teleport me to the Iron Enclave, near [BLUE]Freetown[]! Here is my gold.
Fine, teleport me to the Great Plains Enclave, near [BLUE]Nivarian[]! Here is my gold.
Maybe another time.
Certainly. Say when you're ready...
I am ready!

[BLUE](the man raises an eyebrow)[] The Wizard's Guild enclaves remain neutral among the Kingdoms, and provide invaluable magical services and training to those in need. Assuming, that is, that they can afford it.
What kind of magical services?
Teleportation, purchase of magical ingredients, item crafting, enchanting, advice and research... You name it. Just make sure you have the gold for it.
I am afraid not, maybe in a few weeks, when we receive new goods from Icemist.
Maybe. I am currently conducting some very... Important research. And very urgent. But I am afraid, I need a more experienced adventurer for it. [BLUE](You need to be at least level 7)[]

Maybe. I am currently conducting some very... Important research. And very urgent. If it works, I will be back in Icemist in a good position, and forget about this insufferably hot and decadent town. I need three chunks of [BLUE]living ice[]. I'll offer you a [BLUE]Mystic Vest[] in return.
Not at the time, adventurer.
Okay... I may return later then.
Living ice??? What is that? Sounds... Dangerous.
I have no idea, to be honest. I just found the reference in an old book. But I am offering a good magical item for it, so you find out for yourself. Deal?
Sure, I just hope your research is actually important.
No thanks, I don't think it's worth it.
Just out of curiosity, although I am afraid to ask... What is your 'research' about?
Thanks, goodbye.

Not much people knows this but... I suppose I can trust you. I am going to create magically cold beverages! It will be a hit, here in the Inori. I'll probably brand them with my own name. Soon everyone will be drinking a Couk, and making me rich!
I just risked my life so cold beverages could be served. I feel much better now.
Brilliant! Good luck with it.
Certainly. Say when you're ready...
[BLUE](You can only access this option in the full version of the game)[]
I am ready!
Certainly. Say when you're ready...
[BLUE](You can only access this option in the full version of the game)[]

Welcome to the Inori Enclave, Magus.
I need teleportation using your magic circle.
Do you have anything for sale?
Okay, thanks, but I must be going.
Sure, we can teleport you to one of our enclaves through the Kingdoms [BLUE](he points to a map)[]. The fee for members is [BLUE]150 gold[].
Fine, teleport me to the Sagar Enclave, near [BLUE]Lannegar[]! Here is my gold.
Fine, teleport me to the Iron Enclave, near [BLUE]Freetown[]! Here is my gold.
Fine, teleport me to the Great Plains Enclave, near [BLUE]Nivarian[]! Here is my gold.
Maybe another time.

I am ready!
Sure, have a look.
An old lever, set to the right. And stuck in that position.
An old lever, set to the left. Who knows what will happen if you move it to the right...
Let's see what this does! [BLUE](Push to the right)[]
Yeah... No thanks. I prefer not to touch this.
A deep shriek echoes through the dungeon.
Greetings, hero.
"Welcome back to town, our esteemed hero. You have provided a great service to the city by freeing the fort; I just sent our forces to defend it. From now on, our lands will be safer to travel."
Please don't bother me, can't you see I am an important person?
Thanks! I hope those orcs don't trouble you again. Now, I was told there was a reward...
Of course, of course. I will pay you immediately your [BLUE]2,000 gold coins[], and you can choose one of these items.
I choose the [BLUE]Breastplate of the Forge[]
I choose the [BLUE]Ring of Health[]
I choose the [BLUE]Magma Shortsword[]
I choose the [BLUE]Arcane Pendant[]
Very well, as per the Baron's promise, it is yours.

Hello, old friend. That was a heck of a fight. You should go to town and collect your rewards, if you haven't yet. Looks like rookies can take care of this now. I hear there's a big contract for the Guild in Mercia, ...maybe I'll drag my old butt there.

Here we are, old friend. Tonight we either dine at the Baron's Hall, or in hell. Remember, just kill the Warlord, the rest doesn't matter. We'll just advance straight, feel free to join us, or to go a different path. Good luck.
Don't talk, fight!
I will show those papers to the Baron later. I hope he decides to take some action against the orcs.
Hello, friend. Finally, things are beginning to move. Those documents were very interesting. The orcs are gathering in the old fort to the southwest, under the command of a new Warlord called Xurta.

Finally, give me those papers. Damn... it looks real ugly. Apparently the orcs are up to no good. This should certainly make the Baron nervous. Thanks for this, come again in a few days, I may use your help again.
If you get your hands on some orc battle plans, bring them to me.
Hello again.Damn job,this is not my style.
[BLUE](This officier and his men seem to be watching the southern plain intently. He makes a brief salute with his hand)[] Greetings.
Have a good watch, guys.
You must be the Kingsbridge army commander. Is there any service I can provide for the town?
[BLUE](All the men laugh suddenly at your comment)[] Me? Commander? Ha! Do I look like one of those nobles with parfumed arses?
Well... if you're not from the guard, who are you???
From a distance, maybe. Now it's obvious you're probably a troupe of comedians, right? [BLUE](laugh with them)[]
Hey, don't talk like that about the Lords, it could get us all in trouble.
[BLUE](He smiles)[] Spot on, mate! A travelling troupe of comedians, pretending to be soldiers, and damn good at pretending, ain't we. Some of us believe the role we play, too.

They scare you? Oh, you think they won't invite us to the next dance, or the next deer hunt? With a bit of luck, they'll just send us back to New Garand... nah, they can't even wipe their asses without help.
Okay... who the hell are you, guys?

Sergeant Dumek, from the [BLUE]Warrior's Guild[]. Looks like the Baron is too 'busy' to really care about the orcs to the south. But at least he hired the Guild so we can push them back, if they get too close. This job be damned, this is not my style.
Why not your style? What's the problem?
Goodbye, I must be going.

The nobles only care about their intrigues. They can't see the orcs are a real danger. They're good soldiers, disciplined, strong. It's a mistake to let them roam free like that, one day we'll wake up to greet a thousand of them with siege engines.
Then take your men and go attack them now!
You should explain that to the Baron. I am sure you can convince him he should focus on the orc problem.
Ah, I see. Well, I am quite busy now. Laters.
Maybe I could help you, somehow.
Don't get me wrong, I also play the hero often, but... you are a mercenary. You're getting paid for an easy job. I don't understand why you are so pissed.
I am a hired warrior, there is a contract. If I am ordered to stay here and sit on my thumbs, I must. See, the citizens see us watching here, and feel safe. That's all the Baron cares about.
I already tried that, of course. The man is not stupid, really, but he is a noble. He won't take advice from a lowly merc, in his head he is wiser and smarter than me.
You don't know much about the Warrior's Guild, do you? We're professionals. We do our job right. With honor. Sitting here while a problem gets bigger is not the right thing to do.

Maybe you could bring me some [BLUE]orc battle plans[], maps, letters, orders, etc. They love that kind of battle paperwork, and usually there's couriers carrying them. That might tell us what they're up to, and  open the baron's eyes.
Sure, if I find such documents, I'll bring them to you.
Will I get paid?
Of course, we're mercenaries and know how this works. If the documents are good enough, I'll pay you [BLUE]250 gold[] for them.
I guess the Baron's knights can destroy them easily.
That's great, but I am busy now. I'll be back another time.
The Baron's knights would crush them without breaking a sweat but... apparently they're busy with some tournament. Typical. We have permission to attack the fort, but by ourselves.
That's suicidal, there can be hundreds of them. What will you do?
"I'm trying to gather more forces to launch a quick assault. It's all about killing that Warlord Xurta; with him dead, the orcs will disperse. If we don't kill him, they'll keep coming back."
I want to help!
Has the Baron, at least, offered any reward?
Well, good luck with that, sounds dangerous.

I was hoping you'd say that, I'll be glad to fight at your side. I'll now gather my men and move in front of the fort, let's meet there. Don't try anything yourself, because we need to make sure the Warlord Xurta is in.
You're a nice chap, ain't you? And you've helped us a lot in the past. But I'm old enough to say you're too green for this job. [BLUE](You need to be at least level 9)[]
Okay, I may return later, leave some orcs for me!
Yes, that at least he has done. He has promised those leading the attack a reward of [BLUE]2.000 gold[], plus choosing [BLUE]a magic item[] from his personal vault.
That's not bad, really.
Yeah, but gold and rewards won't kill the orc themselves. Someone has to go and do it.
No, wait, I am not ready yet. Wait here a little longer.
Got it. Let's do this, I am ready.

I see that you bring the Silvery Mace. That means Glaydan's spirit finally rests in peace. I also feel that you are, like me, a Priest of the Three, even if you live as an adventurer. So keep the Silvery Mace as your reward, and wield it proudly, my friend.
I see that you bring the Silvery Mace. That means Glaydan's spirit finally rests in peace. You incurred in great danger for this, so I offer you an amulet as reward.
Welcome again. Remember I still wait for you to find out what happened to Initiate Glaydan, and recover the [BLUE]Silvery Mace[]
[BLUE](the woman salutes and smiles)[] Welcome to the shrine of The Three. May they give you light.
I require healing
Can you answer some questions about The Three?
Can I be of service to The Three?
Goodbye
I can heal you, in exchange of a small contribution to our Shrine.
Here is a small donation. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 25 gold coins, be healed for 25hp)[]
I wish to make a large donation then. Please heal me. [BLUE](Pay 60 gold coins, be healed for 80hp)[]
Not at the moment thanks. I better be on my way.
By the Power of Arbenos, Thelume and Nivaria, be healed of your wounds!
[BLUE](the woman smiles warmly)[] You're honestly asking a priest, if she can talk about her faith? Just ask away, it's my duty and my pleasure to answer your questions.
Are The Three equal as gods, or one is mightier than the others?
I don't want to be rude, but this shrine is not very impressive. Why don't The Three have a bigger temple?
Are there other temples here in Kingsbridge?

The Book of the Moon teaches that The Three were once mortals, but only together they Ascended. There can't be just one of them, without the others. So Arbenos might be the strongest warrior, but only because the other Two exist as well.
Arbenos. That is the Warrior God of The Three, right?

There is nothing divine in war, but yes, Arbenos is The Warrior. The Champion of Justice and defender of the innocent. He defeated the Sorcerer Queen of Orogg, and took in his chest her evil spell of Doom, which would have destroyed the whole Kingdom.
And what happened then?
This is fascinating but I really must be going.

He is a God, so he did not die. But he grew weary, and left to find some rest. It is said, that Arbenos meditates and heals, somewhere in the highest peaks of the Thyr Mountains, until humanity once more needs a Champion
Answer another question for me, please.
Thanks. That's enough teachings for now. I must be going.
What else do you want to know?

[BLUE](the woman chuckles)[] A fair question. Here in Varsilia, the common people mostly worship The Three. But the nobles stick with the old Imperial Religion. They don't trust us very much. So they don't allow us to build temples.

No. The Imperial Religion had a large chapel, but it was razed by the Mercians seven years ago and no one bothered to rebuild it, it seems. Only a few old nobles follow the dead cult, nowadays. I am glad the people are no longer fooled by such blather.
In fact, yes. I can not abandon my post here, and I need someone to find out what happened to Initiate Glaydan.
Tell me how did he disappear.
Sorry but that's a job I can't do right now.

He was on a quest to retrieve a valuable relic, the Silvery Mace. He explored the Inori Desert for weeks, until I received a letter from him. It was good news: he had recovered the mace, and would arrive here in a couple days. But the next night, I was visited in dreams by his restless spirit. I am certain he died.
That doesn't sound good. I am sorry for your loss. So what do you need from me?
I don't like to deal with Ghosts and Spirits, sorry.
I believe he died not far from here. He had sworn to complete his quest, so his spirit will not rest at ease, until the [BLUE]Silvery Mace[] is returned here. May Arbenos guide your blade.

[BLUE](Azeran no longer looks like a feeble bookworm, as he pushes against the ground a bloodied Thalassos. He smiles as he holds the medallion)[] I can't believe you survived all these years. I find it hilarious! you must have been living like a cockroach in those tunnels. [BLUE](He laughs)[]
[BLUE](Coughs blood and looks up in disbelief)[] Ellodis Windmaker! Treacherous monster! How can you still look so young? What sorcery is this?

I have changed my name, it's Azeran now. I've grown more powerful than you can imagine, Thalassos. I will age very slowly, as long as I pay certain price. And with this [BLUE](He raises the medallion)[] I will be able to challenge even your so-called gods. A pity you won't be able to see it.  [BLUE](A bolt of white energy freezes the old priest's lungs, and he dies instantly)[]
"[BLUE](Turns to face you)[] Oh, it is you. A pity you have to witness this; I had no grudge against you."
Oh, but I do have a grudge against you, cheating bastard. Die! [BLUE](Attack)[]
"Oh, don't worry. People betray me all the time, often the same ones who hired me; it's part of the job. How about my payment?"
Let's just pretend I didn't see anything! Works for me.
Wouldn't that be great? But I can't allow you to walk away now that you know my secret, can I?
Makes sense. Time for you to die, then.
I promise I won't say a word.
[BLUE](Trick him)[] Oh, you can. Just pay me, that way I'll be an accomplice to this murder and my silence is guaranteed.

[BLUE](Laughs)[] I like your style. Just never cross my path again, or I'll get rid of you. [BLUE](He throws a bag of gold at your feet. When you look up again, you see him fading away, probably teleporting)[].
[BLUE](Laughs, and makes an arcane gesture. Infernal portals open, and several creatures surround you!)[] I haven't put all my new powers to the test yet. This should be fun.

[BLUE](Your last blow sends Azeran to the ground. He seems about to lose when suddenly his wounds begin to close and his magical barriers raise again, shimmering around him. He laughs)[] Looks like I underestimated you. I won't make the same mistake again, so don't cross my path, adventurer!
Jump on him and try to grab him before he teleports.
Better to let him go... That barrier looks dangerous.

"[BLUE](The shock burns your flesh, rather painfully. You are too late; before you know what happened you are on the ground and Azeran has poofed in a cloud of smoke. However you have something in your hand: the Purple medallion!)[] "
Looks like history repeats itself...
You have already read this book.
The cover says, in archaic Imperial language, 'The Temple of the Sleepers'. This must be about the place mentioned by the Golem!
Let's see if we can learn more about that Temple.
Maybe later.

... It was the first task of our people to find a safe place for the Sleepers to remain, undisturbed. A place where they could be honored and our prayers could be heard. A barrier would be raised, so only those with a Purple Medallion and knowing the Prayer would be able to enter. Here is the Prayer:
Nice and convenient to have the prayer here. Let's read it.
Unfortunately the page has been torn from the book.
... Typical.
You already examined this corpse and noted it in your journal.

This man has been dead just for some years... An adventurer maybe? He was already an old man when he died, and his dead hands still grasp rotten and torn scrolls, probably looted from somewhere in the ruins.
Maybe this guy torn the page. Could it be among these papers?
Poor man. May the Three look after his soul.
Search him for anything valuable.

You examine the rotten papers carefully and there it is! A page of the same manuscript, and indeed it includes the Prayer for the Temple of the Sleepers: 'Five Sleepers under the Mountain shield us from all evil, may their slumber and peace be eternal'
There is nothing useful, nor any of the scrolls seem to be magical nor valuable.
Greetings again, adventurer. We have enough work as it is, so we won't be taking any more special comissions.
[BLUE] (The brawny man nods as you approach)[] Ain't you the adventurer that scared away the goblins? It's not like I missed this job, but I guess I should thank you.
You're welcome. Goodbye.
What can you tell me about the collapsed stairway?
I am sure whatever curse lies beneath us will be eased if we find the remains of that priest. And it may become worse if we do nothing.
They know it's the right thing to do, and I can help you persuade them. [BLUE](Pay 300 gold)[]
Alright, I might return later.

We will remove all those rocks for you, just make sure nothing dangerous crawls out... [BLUE](The foreman blows a whistle and orders the miners to remove the rubble. They organize quickly and carefully begin to remove the rocks and place wooden beams when neccessary)[]
There you go. Let's hope all the legends about the mine being haunted are just that, legends. Good luck with your explorations!

Just your typical bounty-hunting job, but poorly done I'm afraid. We tracked down some criminals for weeks until we caught them here. But the bastards resisted our attack and killed some of my men. We keep them cornered, but we don't have the strength to assault them. Maybe you could help?

"Just a bunch of Varannari scum. Assault, robbery, the usual stuff. Nothing spectacular, this job; but someone has to do it."

"[BLUE](Looks at his comrades, then smirks at you)[] Well, technically speaking these savages are not proven criminals yet. [BLUE](Sighs)[] This is very bad for business, but so be it...
I'm afraid you're already involved, ain't you? You know too much. You must now pick a side, either stinky grassheads or civilized people.
Well said. The grassheads will be pretty harmless if you manage to get rid their leader, Steel Thunder. We'll stay here in case some of them try to escape, good luck!

I have no idea how you did that! Wonderful! You have to explain to me some day.
I can explain it now if you want.
Parting ways with you pains me, but there some urgent things I need to do. I've been abducted for a long time, and I need to seek out those that have been missing me, besides you.
I understand.

Thank you for everything [BLUE](Hugs you)[]. It will not be long before we meet again. I have to show you around Thuram, the land where I was raised. It's time to go, will you prefer to stay here, or you want a lift to New Garand?
I'll stay here. Goodbye, sister.
New Garand would be great. Goodbye, sister.

"[BLUE](Amarisa jumps when you approach; she is obviously expecting an attack at anytime. Then she recognizes you and smiles)[] You came! I never expected to see you again, but I am so glad, brother."
"[BLUE](Amarisa jumps when you approach; she is obviously expecting an attack at anytime. Then she recognizes you and smiles)[] You came! I never expected to see you again, but I am so glad, sister"

[BLUE](You were considering what to say, when suddenly there is a change in her. Simply by looking in your eyes she knows why you are here, as if you knew each other as true siblings should. Tears come to her eyes as she clenches her fists, and finally speaks)[] Goodbye, brother.

[BLUE](You were considering what to say, when suddenly there is a change in her. Simply by looking in your eyes she knows why you are here, as if you knew each other as true siblings should. Tears come to her eyes as she clenches her fists, and finally speaks)[] Goodbye, sister.
... Goodbye, sister.
[BLUE](The aged warrior salutes martially)[] Finally. It took you long enough to arrive.
[BLUE](Be on your guard)[] And who are you?
Greetings, sir. You may be mistaking me for someone else, I'm an explorer trying to find a way towards the Dragon Mountains and their reputed riches.
Relax, I'm not going to jump on you. I'm Sir Valeran D'aer. The Magister asked me to take my best men and come here to ambush you. But as you see, I am not doing that.

Disgusting... a liar and a coward. How fitting for the spawn of Tremadan, the most lowly worm to ever wander this putrid human world. I had hoped to find some trace of honesty, but now my only satisfaction will be your death.
You are a member of the Forsaken, then.  Why didn't you obey your orders and try to kill me?
I don't talk with Forsaken, I kill them.

Oh, worry not, you will still die today. But I am no bandit nor robber. As a Thuramian Arcane Knight and I am bound by honor, even to cowardly worms and pathetic traitor spawns like you. We'll fight cleanly, and the Magister can keep his usual stealthy tricks to himself.
Hey, I am the one that gets to throw witty insults at villains! Now die, Forsaken.
Bound by honor! Yet you are going to destroy humanity, killing every Thuramian, including women and children. Very  honorable. Are you going to offer them a fair fight as well?
Wait, I just want to talk to the Magister.
You waste your lies on me. The Magister has explained us the Horrors are not coming this time, he perfected the ritual. And if they do, I am sure the Kingdoms can defend themselves.
You're just a fool in denial, not a knight. I will stop you.
The Empire couldn't resist, but the Kingdoms will? That makes no sense.

You know the Magister can't be trusted, he'd just say anything. He poisoned my wine and ordered you to ambush me. And the Kingdoms stand no chance to survive the Horrors. You're going to murder thousands of innocents.
I want to speak to your Magister, we might find an understanding.
I don't believe the Horrors will come this time. And if they do, I'm sure they're mostly exaggerations. Meanwhile I'll be enjoying my immortality and receiving honors for having killed you.
You use the word 'honor' a lot, but you have no idea what it means, do you? Time to die.
Are you that blind? The Magister is fooling you. Look at what happened to the Empire.

I will not hide the fact that I don't like the man, but he is the one that found the Ark of Lothasan, the one which knows the Ritual and will make us all immortal. While you are the lackey of a traitor and a coward. I'd rather believe him than you.
He has told you that he knows the ritual, but he might not be able to pull it off, or the Gate might lead you all to death. A big gamble in exchange of murdering so many people.
You have doubts, and that's why we're talking instead of figthing. That's also why you came alone.
I don't ask you to trust my word, I ask you to think for yourself. Tremadan was the greatest and wisest of the Deep Lords, yet he decided to destroy his Gate. You never wondered why?
You ignore too much. The Magister has almost completed the Ritual, the Deep Gate will be ready in a matter of days. And he'll be the first to go in, so he's not fooling anyone.

[BLUE](Your words seem to strike home, but the Muud'ari warrior still looks at you warily)[] You are right. I have doubts. I wish to become immortal and live the glory of my ancestors, but not at any price. I'll let you try to reach the Ark and prove me that you are right about the Horrors.
You are doing the right thing, Sir Valeran.
You know what? I won't allow you to walk away. One Forsaken I kill now is one less I need to kill later.

It's not like you have a big chance to survive the way to the Ark, though. We'll see what you're made of. And if you can't back your claims when we meet again, I won't spare your life. [BLUE](Begins to walk away)[]
We'll meet soon, and I'll prove you the Horrors are real.
Wait! before you go tell me about Amarisa.
Wait! before you go, give me some advice to survive the Wastes.
My advice would be to search the Sunken Citadel, and find something we hid there, to the southwest. Good luck.
He said you might pretend to be friendly, and I see he was right. No, I am afraid it is too late for you.
He said you might pretend to be friendly, and I see he was right. No, I am afraid it is too late for you.

My grandfather was indeed a traitor, but I am not. [BLUE](Making sure nobody else can listen)[] He made me believe I was human, so I don't believe any of his lies. Now that I know the truth I want to join you and become immortal.
Very well, knight. One less enemy I'll have to deal with at the Ark.
Good knight, remember the oaths you once made and come to your senses! The Horrors are real, you must trust me.

"I want to believe you are sincere but you could be fooling me. I do believe in the honor of the mighty; prove your worth by finding the Ark and arriving there by your own means, and I will welcome you into our Brotherhood. The Magister might not be as happy to see you, but if you make it there, I'll vouch for you."
Wait! before you go, give me some advice to survive the Wastes.
The other traitorspawn? She is stubborn, but I have to admit she's brave too. She almost managed to sabotage the Gate, but the Magister caught her and now she's locked up.
[BLUE](He unstraps a greataxe which, upon his command, becomes engulfed in flames)[] Now die!
[BLUE](Amarisa stands as you enter the room. She looks very weak, but still smiles)[] You came! I never expected to see you again, but I am so glad, brother.
[BLUE](Amarisa stands as you enter the room. She looks very weak, but still smiles)[] You came! I never expected to see you again, but I am so glad, sister.
Amarisa! Once more you are their prisoner, but this time I won't leave you here.
No, please focus! Getting me out of here will be useless if the Horrors come out of the Deep Gate. The Forsaken will cross anytime now, forget about me and stop them!
Sister, tell me what has been happening here. And don't worry, I'll both save you and stop them.

[BLUE](She smiles weakly)[] I will need to get used to have a family that cares about me. Well, I haven't always been confined like this. For a while the Magister thought I had sided with them, which allowed me to get closer to the Gate Ritual and blow up all the preparations. That was weeks ago, they needed to start from scratch...
Well done! So you've been here for weeks?

No, I escaped to the lower levels of the Ark. I did my research in the terminals and found about a spirit called the Oracle. Two days ago, when I was about to find his hideout, those bastards captured me again.
I found the Oracle and we have a plan! I need to find a magic box, the Control Module. But forget that now, we need to get you out of here.

"I'm not even sure this Barrier can be deactivated; the Magister left me here and said I'd be greeting the Horrors soon. And even if I got out, I am too weakened to be of much help. Forget about me and carry out that plan!"
I don't know if I'll be able to free you, but I am not going to forget you. I'll be back.
It feels odd to find a regular wooden chest in this location. Probably this has been brought by the Forsaken.
Pry it open, carefully.
You find regular clothes and nothing of value... Until you see it. A magical box obviously crafted by the Muud'ari. It must be the Control Module.
You find regular clothes and nothing of value.
Finally! [BLUE](Take it)[] Now let's find the Main Computer and let's be done.

A familiar voice comes from a small grated hole you as you approach the steel gate. 'Sir Valeran gave you two tasks, stopping the Reactor and killing Amarisa. Until they are completed, you won't be talking to me. Hurry, the Gate does not wait'.
The elevator seems to be out of order.
This will take you to the upper decks and the Forsaken lair. But once you go there, you might not be able to leave for supplies or rest.
I'll return later, I'm not ready.
[BLUE](AUTOSAVE)[] Time to end this. Let's go and face the Deep Gate.
