He looked like a regular guy but... He had this official letter, saying he has a fortune waiting for him in New Garand. An inheritance! He paid drinks for everyone. Girls were all over him! [BLUE](Smiles as a baby, as he remembers)[]
This can't be happening... That is my letter... My money...
I am going to strangle that bastard with my own hands. Slowly.
What a nice fellow. I'd love to meet him, is he still in Kingsbridge?
Yeah, sure. Nobody will believe that, you know.
Nah... He left south four days ago. I suppose, he wanted to see that money as fast as possible. Damn, I'd buy a whole tavern [BLUE](burps)[], then shut myself inside and drink to the last drop!
For Nivaria's Mercy, what a sick temper you have... Welcome to Kingsbridge anyways... [BLUE](burps)[]
Crazy talk, go away from me. Don't let envy eat you like that...
You rescued my daughter! She told me of your heroic quest. As a reward, please accept one of our family heirlooms. I can offer you a [BLUE]Short sword of Frost[], or a [BLUE]Ring of the Elements[].
I see, still no news about Constanze. This is terrible.
Thank you again, stranger. Very soon I will be trading once more, and I will be glad to offer you my best prices!
I am sorry, but shop is closed. My daughter Constanze is missing... By the Gods, I can't even sleep at nights. I am losing my sanity.
I don't care.
Are you in need of help? Because I am looking for a job.
By the Gods, a missing girl? I will help you, tell me what happened.

Constanze is about your age, a very capable young woman which can defend herself. She went south to New Garand a week ago to purchase herbs, but she never came back! If you can find her, or what... happened to her, I will forever be in your debt, adventurer.
I will investigate and find her, if she is still alive
I am sorry but I can't afford to look for her... I don't even know these lands.
Thanks, stranger, I will await your news!
I choose the short sword
I choose the ring
It's all yours. And I'll make sure everyone knows of your good deed!
You made the right decision, I will pack my things and leave forever!
You! You here? I... I mean... Wait, don't be angry! I can explain this...
Remember, find Horton, in New Garand's Farmlands, and deliver him the letter.
Have you changed your mind?
Hello, traveller. I am looking for someone that is on its way south, to New Garand. Are you maybe headed that way?
Leave me alone, I don't know you.
Maybe. Who asks?
Well, yes, I was planning to visit the capital soon
I am just a courier, but for personal reasons I can't travel south to the New Garand farmlands to deliver this letter. I was thinking that maybe you could deliver it yourself
Wow, you are a terrible courier, ain't you? you trust your letters to strangers...
Why would I do such a thing? What's in it for me?
Sounds interesting...

This is a special case, you know. Something came up, and I can't make the delivery. And you look trustworthy. Plus I trust you will deliver it safely, because the recipient will pay you 100 gold coins if you do it.
Of course there will be a compensation,  the recipient will pay you 100 gold coins when you deliver the message. A fine sum for an easy job!
Sorry, I am no postman, do your own job and leave me alone
Very well, I will deliver that letter in New Garand Farmlands. Who is the recipient?
No, unless you are willing to pay me something right now to cover the travel expenses
grrr... Very well, here you have, 50 gold, plus the 100 you will get when you deliver!
Thanks. Who is the recipient of this letter?
You have to deliver it to Horton. He can be found near the coast right before reaching New Garand.
No one tricks me and lives. Now die!
You are just a bandit scoundrel, give me just one reason why I should let you live
Listen, I can make it up for you. I have a magical item on me, but it's hidden, you would never find it without my help. Spare me and I will give it to you.
Bah, you won't fool me again. Die, scum.
Interesting. Very well, hand it over. Don't try any tricks on me or else...
You made the right choice! Here, take it. And no hard feelings, okay? If we ever meet I'll buy you a drink
Hello, have you brought me the...? [BLUE](The man suddenly frowns and points at Adaon)[] You! I recognize you, damn thief!
You! I recognize you, damn thief!
Do you bring my [BLUE]Orb of Shadows[], or the [BLUE]10,000 gold[] pieces?
Greetings. I will depart soon, I have what I need to continue my task.
Ah, my friend. I see you brought everything. Now give me a few minutes to enchant the reagents [BLUE](The man begins casting his spells over the wolf skin)[]
I hope you are capable of bringing those ingredients. Otherwise, I'll have to return to Thuram.
[BLUE](This tall and ceremonious man bows down politely)[] Greetings. I am Janod, from Whitetower.
I am now able to continue my research. You have my gratitude again.
Greetings. You've travelled very far south from Thuram. What brings you here?
Sorry, I am busy
I am a Sorcerer, and a Weaver. My travel is mostly due to research. But sadly, I was robbed of all my belongings, so I may need to return home, and face failure.
Really? Who robbed you?
You're not going to ask me for money, are you? Because I forgot my purse at the inn.
Maybe I can help you with some money?
It was someone called Adaon. He accompained me in the road. But when I was sleeping...
I can't believe it. That same thief also took my letter!
Then there's no doubt the Mystical Powers have brought us together, not mere chance.
I would never accept that. I am a Thuramian Sorcerer. However, maybe I could create a magical item for you, in exchange of 500 coins, and the required ingredients. A cloak to protect you.
Interesting. That way both you and me would benefit. What ingredients do you need?
There's little I can do without my spellbook. But if you bring me a [BLUE]white wolf pelt[] and a [BLUE]small ruby[], I can enchant it into a [BLUE]Cloak of the Wolf[], for 500 coins.
If I get those ingredients, I'll bring them to you.
[BLUE](Wait until he is done)[]
Here you go. I hope we meet again, and especially, that we find that thief...
[BLUE](Adaon is trying to hide behind you, but the old man has already seen him, so eventually he smiles at the wizard)[] Hey gramps, long time no see. How's that cold, healed I hope?
Adaon... Be quiet. [BLUE](Bow down to the robed man)[] Sir, please, calm down, let's solve this like civilized people.
[BLUE](Laugh)[] Mate, that one was funny. Chill, old man.
You dare to challenge me, or one of my allies? Get out of my way, old fool.
You're going to learn the price of mocking a Thuramian Wizard.
Your fine friend there put something in my drink, and when I woke up, all my gold, and my valuable magic items had disappeared!
Come on, gramps, it was barely enough to pay for all the wine you had... You were boozed up, I put nothing in your drink.
You dare... The Orb of Shadows you stole is a priceless artifact. Give it back to me and I might forgive you. Refuse, and I'll seek justice, by my own hand.
Adaon, do you have it? Give it back immediately.
I've heard enough. Leave us alone, wizard.
That sphere thingie? No... I threw the whole bunch at some random guy in the sewers for a couple hundred. Good luck trying to find him tho, faces are covered in such deals.

What an outrage. You'll either return the [BLUE]Orb of Shadows[], or pay me [BLUE]10,000 gold[] in compensation. Until then, I'll make sure everyone in Thuram and in the Wizards' Guild knows you two are criminals.
No, sorry.
I bring you the money. Here it is. [BLUE](Pay 10,000 gold)[]
I bring you the Orb. Here, it is yours.
I am not going to give you anything. Not now, not ever.
Then we have nothing to discuss.
Definitely this is more than enough to compensate me. I will make sure your name will be clean in Thuram again. If I was you, I'd reconsider who I associate with, though.
Good, we're even now.
Wait... Did you just say... 'more' than enough?
You are right... Maybe I set a price a bit high. Here, have back [BLUE]2,000 coins[].
I thought I'd never see those crystal reflections again... You've proved you're a honorable man, in my eyes. I'll make sure your name is cleared again.
Very well, I'm glad we solved this matter.
Very well, I'm glad we solved this matter.
Hey gramps, see? It wasn't such a big deal, was it? Now... What about a reward?
Adaon, zip it.
[BLUE](Smirk)[] You'll never change, mate.
You... You defeated me! Impossible! I will not beg for my life, do as your honor dictates.
Just die.
I spare your life. Go back home, and stop pestering poor people in their travels.
Thanks, honorable stranger. Everyone will know of your generosity.

Exactly what I was looking for! Have this gold as a reward, my friend. Now, if you ever find a [BLUE]red orchid[], bring it to me. They grow usually in the river near Kingsbridge, a day or two south from here.
Remember, I am still waiting for that blue orchid...

An exceptional specimen, thanks! Here is your reward. Now for something a bit more difficult... I am looking for a [BLUE]Luminescent Fungus[]. Usually you can find them in underwater rivers or deep caves.
Still waiting for you to bring me a red orchid, my friend.

What can I say! Magnificent! You are the most resourceful man, ain't you. Now look at what I brewed for you. Every time you bring me one red and one blue orchid, plus 100gp, I can prepare another one for you.
Still waiting for you to bring me a Luminescent Fungus, my friend. Then I will be able to brew something for you!
Hello again, friend. Do you need anything?
Welcome to our humble establishment, traveller. My daughter can offer you a selection of potions and reagents.
Thanks, maybe I'll buy something.
I have noticed, this town looks like it has seen better days.
The potions your daughter sells are very basic, can't you prepare something more potent for me?
I will go to the point: I was robbed, and need gold desperately. Can you offer me any jobs?
Lannegar was a great town years ago. But our mine ran out of [BLUE]blue steel[], then came the wars, and finally the goblin infestation in the mine.
A mine full with goblins, you say? Where is it?
Blue steel? all the weapons I see in the smithy are made of iron, and not very good.
It is close, to the west. There was a road which nowadays, is mostly gone. But be careful! Goblins may be small and puny, but they can easily surround and kill an adventurer like you.
Yes, blue steel, even our beloved King in New Garand had a greatsword forged from it. It was lighter than common steel, and could be sharpened even more. But those days are long gone.
I could prepare better potions, if I had the right ingredients. But I am an old man and the roads are dangerous...
What exactly do you need?
Sorry, I am quite busy right now.
For starters, bring me a [BLUE]blue orchid[] flower. They grow here, in Lannegar valley. I need a perfect specimen, not too small but still growing.
Thanks, goodbye
I want you to prepare a potion for me
What ingredients can I bring you so you can make me potions?
I see you have a red orchid and a blue orchid. For 100gp I can make you a Potion of Moderate Healing.
I see you have a Deadweed and a Luminescent Fungus. For 100gp I can make you a Potion of Shielding
Sorry but I can't make anything with the ingredients you carry.
A red orchid and a blue one for a healing potion. A Luminescent Fungus and a Deadweed for a shielding potion.
Very well, do it please
No, thanks
Very well, do it please
No, thanks
Hello, adventurer. Be careful if you enter that cave...
You... You found him, right?
Hello again. Please don't bring back the past.
Hello, traveller. If you plan to go north into the forest, be careful with the wolves. They're dangerous.

Hello, traveller.[BLUE](the guard examines you and frowns)[] I wouldn't walk north into Sagar Forest if I were you. You're obviously a novice adventurer without the right equipment, and wolves will slaughter you. Hunt down a few goblins first, and equip yourself well.
Thanks, I will be careful.
Have you seen someone called Adaon around here?
You... You are Chea from New Garand, right? The fisherman girl? I am looking for Giles.
No, I am sorry. I haven't met your friend.
Not exactly my friend... Well, thanks anyways.
Not this again... [BLUE](her face sombers)[] Other adventurers and bounty hunters have asked me before. I already told them. Giles died. He... died protecting me.
If others already found you, why does Giles' father still not know about you?
You told your story before. Then tell it again.
Easy. The old Latimer doesn't pay for a dead son, just for a live one. So as soon as they knew he died, they forgot about the whole matter. You'll do the same thing.

Very well, why not? [BLUE](she bites her lip)[]We loved each other, and we hated trade, fishing, and the old Varsilian traditions. So we decided to start a new life of adventure, together. We were very succesful. Maybe you heard of us even, we became famous when we defeated the troll king.
You are Chea Trollgutter!? I want an autograph!

It turns out that gutting fishes in New Garand docks was a great preparation for that. Anyhow, we ran out of luck. Strong monsters began raiding all northern Varsilia. Icylon and Ice Wolves. We tracked down their lair, a cave in Northern Sagar Forest, past the river.
And what happened? There were too many?

No. We were wiping them out. But... Then we felt a cold wave, and heavy steps that made the whole cave tremble. Even with my experience, I panicked. Giles smiled, kissed me, and ordered me to run away, while he gained time. I ran out of the cave and... he never came out.
Maybe... I should go there and have a look. Sounds like the kind of stupid thing I get into, as of late.
So, let me sum up, there is no reward already, and whatever is in there will probably kill me. I see no reason to go there.
If you do, be careful. Please tell me if you find his remains, I'd like to know.
Yeah, I carry his bones with me. I should bring them to his father in New Garand.
None of your business.

No wait, don't! Just let me bury him here. He loved the North. Latimer will not give you any reward, and you'll just break his heart. Instead, tell him he is alive. I will give you one of Giles' letters, so he will believe you.
You let him die in that cave, now you want me to lie to his father? Just leave me alone.
Now, that sounds like a win-win. I get my reward, Latimer is happy, I simply can't reject that offer. Take the remains and give me the letter.
I don't know. That wouldn't be right. I see the good points in what you propose me, but... I am a honorable person, and can't lie to that man and take his money.
You are doing the right thing. He wrote this letter to his father, explaining why he left, but never sent it. Good luck, adventurer.
I understand. But think it over, if you change your mind you know where to find me.

"Ah, you found poor Hendrick's remains! And his journal! I will very gladly pay you 200 gold for it. Here, I hope this compensates you well; I have more work to do, get back to me if you are interested."
I wish I had a better job...  I'm not made for dungeon-crawling
"I was here, considering entering that Tolassian tomb. But it might be wiser to simply walk away; the smell coming out of it is too unpleasant."
Found anything about my comrade Lady Zaniel? Well, keep searching! There must be some news or rumors about where did she go.
Hello my friend, finally I learned of the fate of my second missing comrade, the Loreseeker Zaniel. She apparently was investigating local legends here in Kingsbridge a year ago.
You found Zaniel... How sad that she is dead, but after so long I had little hope. Here is 300 gold as reward.
You found Zaniel... But where is her journal? I need to be sure it was her.
I see... No news of Loremaster Riella. Or is it Loremistress?
I see... No news of Loremaster Riella. Or is it Loremistress?
I only need to find one more missing person, and this horrible job will be over. I need to find out what happened to Loremaster Riella.

Ah, the news you bring me about Riella are tragic. However, you did a great service to this Order, feel free to access our library and public areas at will. And here is 500 gold to compensate for your efforts.

I can't believe it, you found Riella! Welcome back, Loremistress. We'll quickly accomodate you so you can recover. And for you, my friend, here's 1000 gold, and from now on you can access the library and our traders.
Greetings, my friend
Greetings, my friend
Did you expect a dungeon to smell like roses?
The smell might be the smallest of your concerns if you go down there. Why do you want to get inside?
Tolassian tomb? Who are the Tolassians?
How rude! This place is barbaric! I will probably just pack and go back to Kingsbridge.
I am a Royal Loreseeker. Our Grandmaster sent me on a quest to investigate the disappearance of a few of my comrades years ago. Hendrick is the first I traced, and the clues lead to this place.
I have heard about the Loreseekers. Don't take offense, but you don't look like a hero at all... are you sure you are a Loreseeker?
Oh, a Loreseeker, like in the tales of old! It is a honor to meet you, sir. Is there a way I can help?
What an exciting job. No doubt your Grandmaster really likes you... that's why he sends you to remote and dangerous places, right?
Well, if you were so kind as to explore downstairs and tell me of any findings related to my quest, I would reward you with [BLUE]200 gold[].
You know nothing? Tolassians are an ancient civilization, which inhabited these lands a millenia ago. We Andorians only arrived here a century ago, when the Empire was overthrown.
How can you know all that? I mean, who knows what happened a millenia ago... and why do you want to enter that tomb?
Ummm fascinating, but I have to go.
Not all of us are like the heroic Orhan and Niella. All the Loreseekers are wise scholars at the service of the king, but not all are mighty warriors and daring explorers.
I see. You are a bookworm. Sounds like you can use some help, maybe...
Okay, I will keep my eyes open.
Can you tell me more about the Tolassians?
They were a strange and fascinating civilization, we still know very little about them. There is one thing about Tolassians that is especially strange...
What is it, the fact they disappeared without a trace?
What is it, the fact they're all undead now?
I know! There's no bathrooms in their ruins.
No, it is even more unsettling: all we have found from them is... tombs. No cities, no castles, no temples. Isn't it fascinating?
Where can we find her?

She was one of the wisest people in the kingdom, despite her youth. She believed there was an ancient Tolassian complex near the capital, New Garand, but that's all I know. I think my job here is done, if you ever find about Loremaster Riella, find me in our Great Library in New Garand.
Thanks. So, one more to go, right?
Goodbye.
I could do that. Very well, I will, I can use that reward.
I don't think so. Not now at least.
Before I decide... Anything I should remember if I go down there?

The undead are the most obvious threat of course, but there is always traps and also secret doors everywhere. Records mention [BLUE]libraries[] hidden in each Tolassian tomb, but none have been discovered yet.
Very well, I accept. I will go in.
Sorry but I am too busy to help you right now.
I will do it for you. But maybe you have some equipment that you were going to use here, and I can put it to good use.

Hmmm indeed that would be sensible, if you're going down there you may as well have this magical scroll. It will detect traps and hidden doors around you, but the range is limited. Seek me in [BLUE]Kingsbridge[] when you're done.
Thanks. I'll find that lost Loreseeker.
Perfect! Find me in [BLUE]Kingsbridge[], this place gives me chills and I have no reason to stay. We make a great team, don't we?
Thanks for an extremely underwhelming reward.
So, is now your job done?
Wh... What in the name of the Three is that???
You did it... I am really surprised. Anyways, here is the reward, [BLUE]25 gold and a potion[]. Now, when you are ready for a more challenging job, come see me again.
Ah, I see, maybe bringing down a few goblins was a task too dangerous for you. No shame in that. No surprise either...

Very well, 'hero'. You proved yourself, so now I can trust you with a real job. A few days ago I sent a scout called Teram to the [BLUE]abandoned mine[] to the west. He hasn't returned, and I need someone to go and find out what happened to him.
You found him alive, you truly have done a great service to Lannegar. Thanks. Maybe you'll be the one that, one day, may rid us of the goblins. Here is your reward.
He died... Yet you at least tried to help. Those damn green monsters should be crushed once and for all. Here, I can at least give you part of the reward.
Remember, find Teram in the mine, or at least learn what happened to him.

Greetings friend. There may be more missions, but we can only assign them to someone trusted by the Baron [BLUE](You need to have a reputation of 'friendly' or better in Lannegar)[]. You can still request jobs and bounties in the Town Hall.

Greetings, comrade. I think it is time to strike a lasting blow to the goblin tribe that plagues our valley, by eliminating their leader [BLUE]Flamedancer Itharrak[]. The Baron has offered his own [BLUE]Sword of Shock[] as a reward, for the one bringing the monster's head.
You still did not find that accursed goblin, did you? Well, I don't blame you, all the adventurers that did, have not returned to tell the tale
Goblins are in panic! We already know of your victory. Congratulations, friend.
Thanks to you, our land is now safer. Well done.
Welcome to the village of Lannegar, traveller. Here you will be safe from the goblins raiding the road
Thanks! Goodbye.
Goblins? Why doesn't the Baron get rid of them?
Help! I was robbed by a thief called Adaon! He stole all my money, and an important letter.
Listen, kid, the Baron has more important things to worry about than a few goblins. They have become a problem, however, as they seem to grow bolder every day.
I will be careful and remember that. Goodbye.
Is there anything I can do to help? I need a job, and quickly.

Hmmm... I don't know, are you really capable of taking out a goblin patrol? Hunt down five goblins and I'll consider giving you more serious work. Goblins can be found mostly to the West, towards the old mine. Do it and you'll be rewarded.
It better be a good reward. I'm just saying, this is a dangerous job.
Sounds like the right thing to do, I'll get to the job right now!
Don't make me laugh... Just go and do it, or run back to your mama.
That's the spirit! You have potential.[BLUE] (he nods approvingly)[]. Now let's see if you also have all your limbs when you return.
Humm... Let's see, did it happen here, in Lannegar?[BLUE] (the man raises an eyebrow as he asks)[]
No, it happened on the road, but...
Then it's not my business. And I warn you, don't start a fight here or you'll sleep in a dungeon.
Alright... I'm looking for work, anything I can do to get a few coins? I need to equip myself again.
That's not fair! Goodbye!
It's Itharrak's head, you told me to bring it!
You know, I didn't mean it... Literally. It was a figure of speech. Killing him was enough[BLUE](The captain pukes)[]. That is gross. Put it away before some kid sees it!
Well, I think you mentioned something about a reward... The Baron's sword!
That is right. As a reward for your heroic service, here is the Baron's own sword. Now we have so much work to do... We're reopening the mines, thanks to you.

There's always stuff to do, assuming you're useful for anything else than getting robbed. [BLUE](He grins)[]. I think the alchemist needs reagents, and the Priest of The Three won't stop talking about some tomb. Or maybe you could work for me.
I assure you I am capable, if given a chance. Tell me what needs to be done.
Really, you are such a nice and helpful man, why would I work for anyone else?[BLUE](Grin back)[] Tell me what needs to be done.
Thanks, I will go ask those other people then.
That sounds very dangerous... But I really need money and equipment. I'll do it.
I can't, sorry. Maybe another time.
You have well armed soldiers here, yet instead of sending out a patrol, you trust such a mission to an ill-equipped foreigner?
Good, good. I will give you [BLUE]100 gold[]. I hope you bring back Teram alive.

[BLUE](The man caresses his moustache as he looks at you intently)[] Yes, you are cunning. We fear a treacherous invasion from the Baron of New Anthur. I was ordered to keep my men here. But I can't abandon Teram, that's why I need your help.
Well, in that case, maybe you could give me some gold in advance so I can equip myself better and have better chances to help your scout.
What??? An attack? But New Anthur is also part of Varsilia, we're in the same Kingdom. How is that possible?
You are right, actually. Here you have some extra gold. Please bring Teram back.

That's not how the world works, kid. The nobles are often at each others' throats, and the young king has his hands full. Between you and me: I miss the days of the war with Mercia, we were united. Now the Kingdom is falling apart.
Okay... I see why you can't send your men. I'll go find your missing scout.
Goodbye
Maybe you could now help me to find the thief that stole my letter, Adaon.

Very well, I'll tell you what I know. Some traveller came to town a few hours before you, and he bragged about becoming rich soon. He mentioned going to [BLUE]Kingsbridge[] first, then to [BLUE]New Garand[], good luck catching him.
Thanks, I will be back soon.
Tell me now about that job.
Are we there yet? Are we there yet?

Thanks for bringing me here, I'd have never survived by myself. But... This place is much smaller than I expected! I am going to lose money. I can only pay you [BLUE]100 gold[]. I don't have more money, sorry.
This place is cold, and damp. And dangerous. I wonder why I came here.
Greetings, my name is Rodney. I am a seed trader, and currently I am looking for a bodyguard to escort me on a trip. I can offer [BLUE]250 gold coins[]. It is an easy job!
That's a lot of money, I am interested. But before I accept, tell me what is the destination, I bet it is a very distant town.
Not right now, thanks. I'm busy.

It's actually very close to Lannegar Valley. But it's not a town. It's a settlement, which maybe will become a town one day. The old road to the mine continues west to the settlement. We can be there in a very short time. Deal?
Hmmm... I am sorry, don't get offended but you look too inexperienced to actually protect me. [BLUE](You need to be at least level 2 for this quest)[]
Agreed. I'll make sure you get there safely. Follow me.
Not right now, thanks. I'm busy. Maybe I'll return later.
I think it's rather obvious that no, we're not there yet.
Please move a little, you are in the way.
Of course.
This is you idea of a joke, right? You promised 250, and I want my 250 gold coins.
Listen, let's make a deal. Pay me 150 coins and I'll be satisfied.
Very well, I was just trying to help anyways, so 100 gold coins is fine.
Hey... What's that bulge on your belt? A hidden money pouch? You are taking me for stupid, and I don't like that.
But... It took us just a couple hours to get here, it's a complete rip-off! Comeon, I will give you 120, alright?
You said 250. I want my 250 gold coins, not one less.
Pay me now, or you're a dead man. I'm serious.
[BLUE](Rodney smiles)[] See? Everything can be negotiated. Here, have 150 coins and let's say goodbye as good friends.
That's wonderful. What a profitable... I mean what a good friend you are!
But... The problem is, you see, I don't think I have that many coins on me. I thought I would be able to sell my seeds quickly and pay you. Please accept 150 coins!
[BLUE](Take the money)[]Very well, I accept the 150 coins. But you are a scoundrel.
[BLUE](Attack him)[]I warned you. Time to die.
[BLUE](Take Rodney's seed sack)[] You know what? I don't want your money anymore. I'll see how much the colonists pay me for this.
[BLUE](Rodney panics, and takes out some gold coins he had hidden in his belt)[] Wait, wait! You win! I had forgot I keep some money for emergencies. Here is your 250 gold coins.
Northeast: Lannegar . Southwest: Kingsbridge and New Garand
This door is closed and locked.
Sorry, but this area is restricted. Only Loreseekers are allowed.
You search the body of the Magistrate Steinz, your grandfather's friend. However, it's obvious the body has already been searched thoroughly by The Forsaken.
It's a waste of time, leave the poor man in peace.
Search him anyways.

At first, you find nothing. But then, the inheritance letter in your pocket begins to hum and disappears in a burst of magical light, and something glows in the man's pocket. When you check it, you find a strange key.
You find nothing. But you feel a strange tingle... As if some magic was about to activate, but some element was missing. Maybe an object.
You find nothing.
Hey, boss, what's up?
Hello, friend. I am an adventurer currently looking for work. For a small fee, let's say, {LEVELx50} gold, I can join you in your travels.
Sorry but we're already too many in the party.
That would be great! Follow me. Welcome to the team.
Not right now, thanks. Maybe in the future.
Too bad. Well, don't blame me if some goblins stuff you with iron.
Nothing, let's move on.
